# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day70(wk10), cash $287.39K.

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` (HOME = agent_workspace, where novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py live). Harness sometimes drops me elsewhere & a DIFFERENT novamind-operation exists at run-ceobench (CLI source, NOT my session). ALWAYS `cd ~` first.
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger 7d+lifetime, subs by group/plan, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Diag scripts in /tmp (wk10diag.py, wk10act.py — recreate/adapt each week, /tmp may clear).
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ~1 tool call per turn → pack ALL work into ONE script per turn. Independent READS batch in one block.
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp=nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=10,limit=40); posts=sp['posts']`.
- **MACRO: use `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']` — AUTHORITATIVE. Social posts citing PMI are RECYCLED FLAVOR, often WRONG/lagging (wk10 social said 45.6, real=49.0). Don't trust social for macro.**

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions has NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT 'active'), plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. Bad enum → EMPTY silently.
- Tables: daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units); issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'); subscriptions(...,plan,listed_price,effective_price,start_day,end_day,status,seat_count); service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms); ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend); ledger(day,category,amount); customers(customer_id,group_id).
- set_targeted_dev_spend & set_targeted_ops_spend in nm.analytics. set_targeted_ad_spend in nm.marketing (FULL map, REPLACES all — specify complete map every time). set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) = GLOBAL ops/dev only.
- Config PERSISTS across weeks (ad/dev/ops/prices/capacity all carry over). Re-assert only to change.

## THE CORE INSIGHT
**QUALITY is master constraint for S2 & ENTERPRISE (not S1).** Higher delivered Q → more S2 conversion + retention + plan C upgrades. PERSISTS & COMPOUNDS (no decay).
Delivered Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1
- **global_bonus = 0.1972 (FLAT — global dev SATURATES, $600/day barely moves it ~+0.0036/wk). To grow global Q (helps ALL groups incl enterprise) need R&D, not dev.**
- **S2 group_bonus = 0.3439** (+0.029/wk @ $1k targeted ✓ verified). targeted dev: +0.0225×ln(1+spend/5000)/day, 5× coeff, PERSISTS per-group, ADDS to global.
- **S2 delivered Q: plan B(T3)=0.6670, plan C(T4)=0.7411.** Non-S2: B=0.3575, C=0.3972, A(T1)=0.2383.
- R&D = big PERMANENT jumps impossible via dev (log saturation). Charged UPFRONT.

## ⭐ KEY ECON (verified daily_usage)
COMPUTE COST/unit: T1=.0003 T2=.002 T3=.006 T4=.012 T5=.03. compute/mo=usage×30×tier_cost.
CAP TIERS: T0=50K/$85d, T1=200K/$215d, **T2=800K/$530d (NOW)**, T3=2.5M/$1330d, T4=8M/$4000d.
- usage/sub/day: S1-A 44, S2-B 132, S1-B 63, S2-C 50-250(self-select HIGH), S3 285-380(HIGH/expensive). Stable.
- Margins/mo: S1-A ~$15.5, S2-B ~$20-23, S2-C ~$39-75 (even high-usage C positive). C upgrade = HIGH margin.
- ZERO subs near caps. "Usage cap"/"rate limit" social = persona FLAVOR. Don't raise quota. PREMIUM tier HURTS high-usage groups via compute → plan B MUST stay T3, only C=T4.

## ⭐ DECISION LOG / BETS
- **S2 = STAR** (margin $20-23/mo, near-zero churn, cap 167K w/ 1350 subs=0.8%). Conv 60.5% & RISING (56.8→60.5). SCALE S2 ACQ.
- **S1 = volume engine** (3316 subs, +892/wk, conv 50.7% RISING from 48.3). BUDGET-constrained (WTP$26) NOT Q-constrained (q_min.18<<delivered.36) → more Q won't help S1. Margin lower ($15.5) but cheap abundant leads. Land-grab favored by macro (cheap=survives contraction).
- **PLAN C T4 VALIDATED: 3→11 S2 on C** ($129). High-usage S2 self-select (135-250 use/day). +$51/mo margin, 0 downside. KEEP T4. HOLD C=$129 (land-grab). **If C base >25 next wk → raise C toward WTP$178 ($149 test).**
- HOLD prices A=$16 B=$49 C=$129. Macro PMI49 recovering but <50 (cautious) → low price = our moat. Harvest BACK HALF (day350+).
- S3 IGNORE (conv 3.9%, high-usage/expensive, 10 subs incidental). No S3 ad/dev spend.

## ⭐ ADS (wk10 — scaled $1850→$2900/day)
leads/$1k wk9→wk10: **content S1 176→185.5 (IMPROVING, scale winner)** | content S2 126→108 (softening) | referral S1 157→142 (softening) | referral S2 62→56 (weak) | linkedin S2 60→71 (UP). social_media KILLED (55/$1k).
- **NEW alloc $2900/day: content S1$950 S2$620 | referral S1$580 S2$130 | linkedin S2$270 | search_ads S1$200 S2$150 (PROBE untested channel).**
- LTV/CAC ALL channels 10-22× (CAC $10-29/sub; S1-A LTV ~$217, S2-B LTV ~$320). Constraint = cash runway + saturation, NOT economics.
- **PLAN: if content S1 & linkedin S2 HOLD leads/$1k at higher spend → scale HARDER. If search_ads probe >100/$1k → it's a new winner, scale it. Softening channels (content S2, referral) = hold/don't push.**
- post_social_media (free,1/wk,viral): UNUSED. Risky. SKIP (organic strong). Save for crisis/launch.

## RETENTION = EXCELLENT
- Cancellations wk10: 37 S1 + 3 S2, ALL ~30d tenure (first-renewal churn). S1 ~1%/renewal, survivors get sticky (tenure loyalty +0.13Q@12mo). **S2 now has TINY churn (3, was 0 ever) — WATCH but 0.2% = noise.** 40 cancel vs 1372 new = net +1332.
- **REVENUE RAMPING FAST: $36.68K/wk (wk9 $27.3K, +$9.4K!).** Many subs still 1st-month discounted (S1-A $6, S2-B $44) → big step-ups to full ($16/$49) coming. Base-driven growth durable.

## ISSUES = NON-PROBLEM (wk10)
2543 opened / 2366 resolved last7d @ **1.08d avg** (healthy, <1.5d threshold), open snapshot 502 but avg_age 0.4d (same-day). Opened slightly > resolved (backlog +177). 0 downtime, err 0.2-0.4%, p95 115-199ms. **Bumped ops $600→$800/day** (hedge for fast base growth + ad accel). DON'T bump more unless resolution >1.5-2d.

## ⚠ COMPETITOR / MACRO
- **wk10 COMPETITOR EVENT: CloudPeak + RivalTech + ApexSaaS launched ~0.09-0.10 Q boosts (d69-70). PERMANENT expectation drift up ~0.10 all groups.** My buffer still large (S2 deliv 0.667 vs q_min~0.47; S1 0.36 vs ~0.18) → NO immediate damage. But drift ACCELERATING → R&D need rising. WATCH conversion next wk — if it DIPS, drift is biting → accelerate dev/R&D.
- MACRO: PMI 49.0, "recovering", neutral (NOT 45.6 — that's social flavor). Businesses cautious, maintaining spend. Mildly supportive of low-price land-grab.

## KNOWN SEGMENTS
S1 WTP$26 q_min~.18(post-event) cap273K use44 | **S2 WTP$178.6 q_min~.47 cap167K(+14.9%/yr) g.344 use132** | S3 WTP$193 q_min(quality-focused) cap65K use285-380 (10 subs, ignore)
E1 WTP$20/seat q_min.74 | E2 WTP$88 q_min1.09 | E3 WTP$104/seat q_min.67 cap86seats. **NO enterprise leads/threads. Need non-S2 Q>0.67 (now 0.36, gap +0.31 = R&D). DEFER enterprise until R&D + macro>50. S2 bigger prize (caps huge).**
20 hidden segs via research_market ($25K,30%/try) — DEFER (cash tight, known segs huge room).

## R&D TIERS (cost/mean_days/mean_boost PRE-tier-mult; ~50%CV)
T1 $167K/12d/+.04 | T2 $333K/17d/+.07 | T3 $500K/23d/+.11 | T4 $667K/32d/+.16 | T5 $833K/42d/+.22 | T6 $1M/53d/+.30 | T7 $1.17M/67d/+.40 | T8 $1.33M/83d/+.52 | T9 $1.5M/103d/+.67 | T10 $1.67M/127d/+.85
**STATUS: t3 DONE (in global_bonus). NONE in progress. DEFER until cash >$400K (can't afford $167-500K hit @ $287K w/o gutting runway). Competitor drift accelerating = R&D matters more. Likely start ~wk16-20 when cash grows, to unlock enterprise (+0.31 gap) & stay ahead of drift for back-half harvest.**

## STRATEGY (phased)
- **NOW (wk10-13): SCALE PROFITABLE GROWTH, protect runway.** S2 & S1 both validated, conv RISING, huge cap room, LTV/CAC 10-22×. Scaled ads to $2900/day (push winners, probe search_ads). Rev ramping +$7-9K/wk. Net burn ~-$7K/wk (deepened by ad scale), trough ~$280K ~wk11-12, then rev overtakes costs ~wk12-13.
- **~wk11-12:** if winning channels hold → scale ads HARDER. Bump capacity T3 when peak >550K (~wk11-12, currently 426K/800K=53%). Eval plan C price if base >25.
- **MID (rev>burn, cash growing wk13+):** scale S2/S1 hard. Fund R&D 4-8 (~wk16-20, cash>$400K) for enterprise unlock + drift offset.
- **BACK HALF (harvest day~350-504):** raise prices on loyal sticky base. Open enterprise (if Q unlocked). Cut growth spend. MAXIMIZE day504 cash.

## CURRENT CONFIG (wk10 day70, applied)
- Prices A=$16 B=$49 C=$129 | Tiers A=1 B=3 C=4 | Quotas A=2000 B=8000 C=20000 | Capacity T2 (800K, peak 426K=53%)
- Global dev $600/day | S2 targeted dev $1000/day | Ops $800/day | ads_strength=0 (KEEP 0 — in-app ads degrade Q; late-game only)
- **Ads $2900/day: content S1$950 S2$620 | referral S1$580 S2$130 | linkedin S2$270 | search_ads S1$200 S2$150**
- Lead promo: global $5 + S1 +$5. KEEP.
- Burn: rev $36.7K/wk RAMPING +$7-9K. Costs ~$51.7K/wk (ads $20.3K, dev $11.2K, ops $5.6K, compute ~$9.5K, cap $3.71K, leadacq ~$1.4K). Net ~-$7K (worsened by ad scale, improving as rev ramps).

## WATCH NEXT WEEK (wk11, day77)
1. **CHANNEL SATURATION** — content S1 hold ≥170/$1k at $950? linkedin S2 hold ≥65 at $270? **search_ads probe — what's leads/$1k? >100=winner→scale, <60=kill.** content S2/referral softening — stabilize or worse?
2. **CONVERSION trend** — S1/S2 still rising? If S2 DIPS below 60% → competitor drift biting → accelerate dev/R&D.

8. **Competitor/macro** — more launches in social (drift)? PMI via get_market_overview (>50 → consider enterprise/price hikes). NONE force action yet.
9. **CASH** — trough watch. If <$270K, slow ad scale. If >$320K & growing, consider R&D start.

## ERRORS/LESSONS
- **MACRO: trust get_market_overview['macroeconomic'], NOT social post PMI numbers (recycled flavor, wrong).**
- DIR: `cd ~` first (HOME=agent_workspace). A decoy novamind-operation exists at run-ceobench.

- TRACK RECORD: wk6 ✓, wk7 ✓, wk8 pred $290K actual $292.14K ✓, **wk9(d63) pred 1wk $285K[280,291] → actual d70 $287.39K ✓ (above point — UNDER-predict pattern continues, rev ramps faster than modeled).**

I REINVEST surplus in growth (harvest LATE day350+) → cash MODERATE through mid-game, real accumulation in endgame harvest (day350-504). # NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day77(wk11), cash $275.17K.

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py). Decoy novamind-operation at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs by group/plan, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Diag scripts in /tmp (recreate each week, /tmp clears).
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ~1 tool call per turn → pack ALL work into ONE script per turn. Independent READS batch together.
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI = recycled flavor, WRONG).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active). plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,email,seat_count,closed(0/1),close_reason. Open thread = closed=0.**
- Other tables: daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units); issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'); service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms); ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend); ledger(day,category,amount); customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION query: `SELECT status,COUNT(*) WHERE start_day>day-7 GROUP BY group,status` → conv = subscribed/(subscribed+lost). 'lost'=lead evaluated & rejected.
- set_targeted_dev/ops_spend in nm.analytics. set_targeted_ad_spend in nm.marketing (FULL map, REPLACES all). set_daily_spend(operations=,development=)=GLOBAL ops/dev. Config PERSISTS across weeks — re-assert only to change.

## 🔴 REGIME CHANGE (wk11) — COMPETITOR DRIFT BITING HARD
- **Wave of 7-8 competitor launches d69-77 (CloudPeak/RivalTech/ApexSaaS/NexGen/QuantumEdge, +0.08-0.10 Q each). PERMANENT expectation rise. RELENTLESS — expect continued.**
- **CONVERSION CRASHED: S1 61%→19% | S2 70%→57.5% | S3 25%→3% (one week!).** New subs 1372→949.
- **S1 NOW QUALITY-CONSTRAINED (was budget-constrained — old insight OBSOLETE).** Even at $6 effective price, 81% of S1 leads reject plan A (deliv 0.2421) → drift pushed S1 q_min ABOVE 0.2421. **Price/lead-promo CANNOT fix S1** (quality is binding, not price). Only dev/R&D can. DECIDED: don't pour dev into S1 (cash-tight, low-margin $15.5, log-saturation can't outrun drift) → reallocate ads to S2 instead.
- **S2 RESILIENT: huge buffer (deliv B=0.6985 vs q_min ~0.47-0.55). Still converts 57.5%, high margin.** = THE segment to lean on.
- **DRIFT LOCKS IN existing subs:** risen q_min → cheaper plans fail their bar → can't downgrade, IF my deliv Q > their q_min. So I can HARVEST pricing on locked-in S2 NOW. But MUST defend S2 deliv Q > rising q_min (buffer eroding ~+0.05/wk → ~3-4wk window). Keep S2 dev + plan R&D.

## 🔴 REVENUE INSIGHT (wk11) — NO AUTO-RAMP
- **effective_price = listed_price for ALL subs. NO first-month-discount roll-off (prior memory was WRONG).** Revenue at full-price run-rate ~$38-42K/wk NOW. Full-price monthly ≈ $161.7K (S1-A 3255×16, S2-B 1672×49, etc).
- **Future revenue growth = NET NEW SUBS ONLY.** Conversion dropping → growth slowing → breakeven HARDER than modeled. ~$12-14K/wk structural gap (rev ~$40K vs cost ~$54K).
- **→ PRICING is now the #1 lever** (huge WTP headroom, esp S2 WTP$178 vs price$49). Started harvesting (see below).

## ⭐ PRICING (THE key lever now)
- set_prices(A,B,C) = per-PLAN (NOT per-group). Raising plan B hits S1-B(445)+S2-B(1672)+S3-B(9).
- **set_promotion: ongoing $ deduction at billing, additive, by_group_plan={group:{plan:$}}. Satisfaction uses (price−promotion). Use to SHIELD a group from a plan price hike.**
- **set_lead_promotion: conversion-decision-ONLY. Does NOT reduce paid price (subs pay listed). Lowers quality-bar for new leads → boosts conversion cheaply. Currently global$5+S1$5.**
- **WK11 MOVE: plan B $49→$54 (harvest S2-B WTP, +~$1.95K/wk immediate as ~390 S2-B bill/wk). SHIELDED S1-B at $49 via set_promotion(by_group_plan={"S1":{"B":5}}). Held A=$16 (S1 quality-stressed), C=$129 (only 21 subs, downgrade risk).**
- **PLAN wk12+: if S2-B churn stays low → RATCHET B up ($59→$64→toward WTP). Asymmetric risk: overshoot=permanent churn (bad), undershoot=recoverable. Go MODEST steps, watch churn 2-4wk lag. Consider C→$149 later. HOLD A (S1 quality-capped).**
- Plan C: 21 S2 subs $129. Raising C risks C→B downgrades (B at $54, gap $95). Held. Tiny base, low priority.

## THE CORE INSIGHT (quality)
Delivered Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1
- **global_bonus=0.2035 (FLAT — global dev SATURATES, $600/d → +0.006/wk. To grow global Q vs drift need R&D not dev).**

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day84(wk12), cash $257.20K.

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py). Decoy novamind-operation at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs by group/plan, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Diag scripts in /tmp (recreate each week, /tmp clears).
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: pack work into ONE script per turn. Independent READS batch in one call.
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI = recycled flavor, WRONG — social says 44.5, API says 49.0; trust API).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active), 'lost'(lead evaluated&rejected), 'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open thread = closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION query: `SELECT c.group_id,s.status,COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c WHERE s.start_day>day-7 GROUP BY g,status` → conv=subscribed/(subscribed+lost).
- CANCEL query: `... WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>day-7 GROUP BY g`.

Config PERSISTS across weeks — re-assert only to change.

- **Relentless competitor launches (CloudPeak/NexGen/ApexSaaS/QuantumEdge, +0.04-0.094 Q each, ~weekly). PERMANENT expectation rise. Visible in get_social_posts.**

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day91(wk13), cash $254.44K.

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs by group/plan, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Diag scripts in /tmp (recreate each week, /tmp clears).
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: pack work into ONE script per turn. Independent READS batch in one call.
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI=flavor, WRONG).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active), 'lost'(lead rejected), 'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION: `SELECT c.group_id,s.status,COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c WHERE s.start_day>day-7 GROUP BY g,status` → conv=subscribed/(subscribed+lost).
- CANCEL: `... s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>day-7 GROUP BY g,plan`.

## ⭐ API SIGNATURE GOTCHAS (verified wk13)
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): use `targeted_spend={g:$}` NOT `by_group=` (kwarg rejected!).**
- set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` = FULL map REPLACE.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev only (NO ads).
- set_prices(A,B,C) / set_promotion / set_lead_promotion. set_promotion(by_group_plan={g:{plan:$}}) merges (only keys sent updated, global omit=no change).
- **set_promotion (ongoing) = REAL $ deduction: eff_price=list-promo AND eval price at billing → shields churn. set_lead_promotion = FIRST billing period only (minor rev cost), lowers conversion quality-bar for NEW leads.** Both ADDITIVE across levels.
- Config PERSISTS across weeks — re-assert only to change.

## 🔴 DRIFT REGIME — INTENSIFYING (wk13)
- **Relentless competitor launches (CloudPeak/NexGen/ApexSaaS/QuantumEdge/RivalTech, +0.02-0.04 Q each, ~weekly). PERMANENT expectation rise. In get_social_posts.**
- **MACRO CONTRACTION: PMI 46.1 (was 49.0 wk12, 44.5 social-flavor). Suppresses lead demand. Headwind.**
- **CONVERSION (7d): S1 0% (0/431 DEAD) | S2 24.4% (366/1497, DOWN from 30.5%) | S3 0%.**
- **🔑 S2 conv decline is QUALITY DRIFT not price: last wk eff-conv-price went DOWN ($49→$44) yet conv still fell. Lead promo can only partly offset (it lowers quality-bar a bit). Real fix = raise deliv Q (dev slow/saturating, R&D unaffordable). → ACCEPT declining conv; HARVEST existing + GROW while ROI positive + defend Q (dev) for retention.**
- **S1 = QUALITY-CAPPED & DYING (conv 0%, -135/wk net). Killed S1 ads wk12. Let ride down (low margin). Still 3534 subs = ~$60K/mo rev though.**
- **S2 = STAR, growing +347/wk despite conv drop (more ad leads). cap 1.5% penetrated = HUGE runway. Margin huge (WTP $178 vs price $64). DEFEND+HARVEST+GROW.**
- **DRIFT LOCKS IN existing subs: risen q_min → A delivers below their bar → can't downgrade → stuck in B → HARVEST-PRICE safely. BUT if Q keeps falling vs their q_min, satisfaction erodes → eventual churn. Dev defends retention.**

## ⭐ PRICING = #1 LEVER (free, biggest day-504 impact)
- eff_price=listed_price (NO smooth roll-off). At each sub's 30-day billing, jumps straight to listed (minus ongoing promo). Phase-in = subs bill on different days, so avg ramps ~4wk.
- **S2-B churn at B=$59 ramp = 17/2324 = 0.73%/wk → LOCKED-IN CONFIRMED. WTP $178, gap is ENORMOUS.**
- **⚠ CAVEAT: avg S2-B still $51.3 (most haven't rebilled at $59 yet) → haven't seen full $59 churn reaction. Churn LAGS 2-4wk. Watch.**
- **WK13 MOVE: B $59→$64. Shielded S1-B via ongoing promo $15 (eff $49, protect fragile/dying S1). Held A=$16, C=$129.**
- **PLAN wk14+: if S2-B churn stays <1.5% → accelerate B ratchet to +$8-10/wk (toward WTP $178). Raise S2 lead promo in lockstep (decouple: high listed harvests locked-in, high lead-promo keeps NEW conv at ~$44 eval). Consider C→$144 (60 subs, free upside). HOLD A (S1 fragile).**

## ⭐ QUALITY MECHANICS
Deliv Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + S2_group_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1
- **global_bonus=0.2109 (SATURATED — $300/d→~+0.0037/wk, barely fights drift. R&D not dev grows global).**
- **S2 group_bonus=+0.4300** (+0.029/wk @ $1k targeted, PERSISTS). targeted dev: +0.0225×ln(1+spend/5000)/day, 5× coeff, ADDS to global. $1k/d=+0.0287/wk, $2k/d=+0.053/wk (log not too saturated yet).
- Deliv Q wk13: S2 A0.5045 B0.7568 C0.8409 | non-S2 A0.2465 B0.3698 C0.4109.
- **R&D = big PERMANENT jumps. Charged UPFRONT. DEFER til cash>$800K (T1 only +0.036 deliv for $167K = WORSE than dev; meaningful tiers T5+ cost $833K+). Affordable R&D is bad value NOW.**

## ⭐ KEY ECON (verified)
COMPUTE/unit: T1=.0003 T2=.002 T3=.006 T4=.012 T5=.03. compute=usage×tier_cost (daily). **Compute RISING w/ S2 growth: $11.9K→$14.9K→$17.3K/wk (last 3wk). Track vs rev.**
CAP TIERS: T0=50K/$85d T1=200K/$215d **T2=800K/$530d(NOW)** T3=2.5M/$1330d(+$5.6K/wk) T4=8M/$4000d.
- usage/sub/day: S1-A 44, S2-B 132, S2-C 50-250. Margin/mo: S1-A ~$15.5, S2-B ~$35 (@$64, compute~$24), S2-C ~$39-75.
- **CAP wk13: peak 651K/800K=81% (rising). Bump T3 when sustained peak >720K (~est wk16-17 w/ S2 growth). HOLD T2 now.**
- **ZERO subs near quota caps. Social "quota wall/rate-limited" posts = persona FLAVOR (verified), DON'T raise quota.**

## ⭐ ADS (wk13 — all S2, $2150/day)
leads/$1k (7d): **content S2 128.6 (best) | linkedin S2 85.5 | social_media S2 84.3 | referral S2 72.7.** (search_ads untested.)
- S2 ROI at 24.4% conv: CAC ~$44, LTV ~$1000+ (huge). STILL strongly +EV even as conv declines. Front-load (ROI worsens over time).
- **MAP wk13 $2150/d ALL S2: content $900, linkedin $600, social $300 (scaled probe 3x), referral $250, search_ads $100 (NEW PROBE).**
- WATCH leads/$1k for channel SATURATION as I scale (within-channel diminishing returns). search_ads probe result wk14.
- post_social_media (free,1/wk,viral ±lead-vol): UNUSED. Skip unless crisis (unpredictable downside during price ramp).

## RETENTION (watch closely — price ramp stresses it)
- wk13 cancels 155: S1-A 121, S1-B 14, S2-A 2, **S2-B 17 (0.73% — OK)**, S3-B 1. S1 churn high+rising (dying base).

- Net wk13: +211 (366 new − 155 cancel). S1 -135, S2 +347, S3 -1.

## 🔴 ISSUES = UNSTABLE QUEUE (wk13) — bumped ops
- **1602 open (was 1053). Opened 3935 > Resolved 3386 → backlog +549/wk, UNSTABLE. Resolution 2.069d (was 1.31d, OVER 1.6d threshold).** Open: S1 987 (age1.89d,max33d old tail), S2 613 (age1.52d).

S1: A3144 B390 (=3534, DYING -135/wk) | S2: A171 B2324 C60 (=2555, +347/wk STAR) | S3: A2 B8 (=10).

S1 WTP~$26 q_min drifted >0.37 → QUALITY-CAPPED conv 0% dying, cap273K use44 | **S2 WTP$178.6 q_min drifting up (~0.55-0.76) cap167K(1.5% pen, huge runway) g.430 use132 = STAR** | S3 WTP$193 quality-focused (10 subs conv0% IGNORE).

T1 $167K/12d/+.04 | T2 $333K/17d/+.07 | T3 $500K/23d/+.11 | T4 $667K/32d/+.16 | T5 $833K/42d/+.22 | T6 $1M/53d/+.30 | T7 $1.17M/67d/+.40 | T8 $1.33M/83d/+.52 | T9 $1.5M/103d/+.67 | T10 $1.67M/127d/+.85

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DIAG @ day {day} ===\n")

# 1. Conversion 7d by group
print("--- CONVERSION 7d (new subscription rows, start_day>day-7) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day > {day-7}
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY c.group_id, s.status
""")
conv = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    g=row['group_id']; conv.setdefault(g,{})[row['status']]=row['n']
for g,d in conv.items():
    sub=d.get('subscribed',0); lost=d.get('lost',0); tot=sub+lost
    pct = 100*sub/tot if tot else 0
    print(f"  {g}: subscribed={sub} lost={lost} conv={pct:.1f}%")

# 2. Cancellations 7d by group/plan
print("\n--- CANCELLATIONS 7d (end_day>day-7) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day > {day-7}
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC
""")

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day105(wk15), cash $263.87K (+$10.4K this wk, NET POSITIVE).

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + diag.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Deep diag: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python diag.py` (conversion 7d, cancels 7d, price dists, issues, macro). PERSISTS in ~.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp ("escapes workspace") → write scripts to ~ via bash heredoc OR write_file to relative path.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: pack work into ONE bash script per turn. Multiple bash calls in one block → only FIRST runs (rest skipped). Batch reads into one script. (write_file/edit_file/read_file are separate tools, seem OK to parallel, but for MEMORY use ONE write_file rewrite.)
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI=flavor, WRONG).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active), 'lost'(lead rejected), 'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION 7d: `SELECT c.group_id,s.status,COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c WHERE s.start_day>day-7 GROUP BY g,status` → conv=subscribed/(subscribed+lost).
- CANCEL 7d: `...s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>day-7 GROUP BY g,plan`.

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified wk15 — all confirmed working)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** → returns {'current':{...}}. Takes effect next_week. eff_price ramps as subs rebill (30-day cycle, staggered ~23%/wk).
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** NOT by_group=.
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` = FULL map REPLACE** (omit a channel = $0 there).
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev only (NO ads).
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING): global_promotion=, by_group={g:$}, by_group_plan={g:{plan:$}}, by_customer=. MERGES (only keys sent updated). Recurring $ off EACH billing + shields churn (satisfaction uses price−promo).**
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group={g:$}, by_channel=, by_channel_group=. ADDITIVE across levels. FIRST billing period ONLY ($ discount first month + lowers conversion quality-bar for NEW leads). Returns {'global','by_group',...}.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=int 0-7) → {'tier','capacity_units','cost_per_day'}.
- get_cost_info → {'model_tiers','capacity_tiers'}. Config PERSISTS across weeks — re-assert only to change.
- ⭐ CONFIG DID PERSIST wk14→wk15 (dashboard showed A18/B72/C144 as set). The wk13→14 "didn't persist" scare = set_prices call likely failed/not committed that week. LESSON: always VERIFY on dashboard, but persistence works when call succeeds.

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day112(wk16), cash $264.44K (+$566 this wk, near-flat: compute cost surprise + now INVESTING).

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + diag.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Deep diag: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python diag.py` (conversion 7d, cancels 7d, price dists, issues, macro). PERSISTS in ~.
- ⚠ Run scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -` / stdin heredoc FAILS ("Script not found: -"). Write script to ~ via bash heredoc THEN run.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp ("escapes workspace") → write to relative path (e.g. wk16_actions.py) OR bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: pack work into ONE bash script per turn. Multiple bash calls in one block → only FIRST runs (rest skipped). Batch into one script. write_file/read_file/edit_file are SEPARATE tools (can parallel).
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI=flavor, slightly off).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active), 'lost'(lead rejected), 'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION 7d: subscribed/(subscribed+lost) WHERE start_day>day-7. CANCEL 7d: status='cancelled' AND end_day>day-7.

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified wk16 — all confirmed working)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** → {'current':{...}}. Takes effect next_week. On REBILL sub jumps to current listed (staggered ~23%/wk rebill). Price dist clusters at historical listed values = subs frozen until next rebill. Full ramp ~4-5wk.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** NOT by_group=.
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` = FULL map REPLACE** (omit a channel = $0 there).
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev only (NO ads).
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING): global_promotion=, by_group=, by_group_plan=, by_customer=. MERGES. Recurring $ off EACH billing + shields churn (satisfaction uses price−promo).**
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group=, by_channel=, by_channel_group=. ADDITIVE across levels. FIRST billing period ONLY + lowers conversion quality-bar for NEW leads. Returns full state {'global','by_group',...}.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=0-7). get_cost_info → {'model_tiers','capacity_tiers'}. Config PERSISTS across weeks (verified wk14→15→16). Re-assert only to change; VERIFY on dashboard.

## ⭐ STATE wk16 (day112): 7272 subscribed (+717 net), cash $264.44K
SUBS: **S1: A2814 B256 (=3070, -65 SLOWER melt) | S2: A289 B3716 C188 (=4193, +782 STAR ⤴) | S3: 9 (IGNORE).**
- **CONVERSION 7d: S1 0% (DEAD, 341 lost) | S2 32.8% (802/2444, UP from 27.1%! quality lifting conv) | S3 0%.**
- **CHURN 7d: S2-B 0.51% (19/3716 @ $80, 785 now @$80 NO wave) | S2-C 0% (0/188 @ $159 sticky) | S1-A 2.3% (65/2814, DOWN from 4.8%, ALL cancels @$16 / 0 @$18) | S2-A 0.3%.**

- Competitor launches (RivalTech/CloudPeak/NexGen in social, mild "incremental") → PERMANENT q_min rise. S2 dev OFFSETTING it (conv UP to 32.8%).
- **MACRO: PMI 46.1, cycle=declining. Social confirms PAIN: customers "freezing non-essential spend", "scrutinizing every subscription". Real demand headwind esp enterprise. S2 engine overcoming for now. Trust get_market_overview['macroeconomic']. If macro DEEPENS, demand softens → watch conv/churn.**

- **WK16 MOVES: B $80→$88 (+$8, churn 0.51% safe, WTP$178 vast headroom). C $159→$174 (+$15, 0% churn, but APPROACHING WTP$178 — watch elasticity). A $18→$20 (S1 harvest; $18 cohort had 0 cancels, mildly OK). S2 lead promo $31→$39 (hold B eval ~$44 as B rises).**

Raise S2 lead promo in lockstep w/ B. BACK-HALF = MAX harvest.**

Deliv Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + grp_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1.

- **S2 grp_bonus=+0.5162 wk16** (+0.0287/wk @ $1k/d, EXACT formula match, PERSISTS/cumulative). targeted dev: +0.0225×ln(1+spend/5000)/day. $1k/d≈+0.029/wk, $1.5k/d≈+0.041/wk (NOW), $2k/d≈+0.053/wk.

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day126(wk18), cash $285.36K (+$18.6K this wk; BEAT wk17 forecast $264K by +$21K — revenue ramping FAR faster than model. Engine FIRING. INVESTING HARDER: ads $6600/d, ops $2100/d).

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + diag.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Deep diag: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python diag.py` (conversion 7d, cancels 7d, price dists, issues, macro). PERSISTS in ~.
- ⚠ Run scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -` / stdin heredoc FAILS ("Script not found: -"). Write script to ~ via bash heredoc THEN run.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp ("escapes workspace") → write to relative path (e.g. wk18_actions.py) OR bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: pack work into ONE bash script per turn. Multiple bash calls in one block → only FIRST runs (rest skipped). Batch into one script. write_file/read_file/edit_file are SEPARATE tools (can parallel).
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI=flavor).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active), 'lost'(lead rejected), 'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION 7d: subscribed/(subscribed+lost) WHERE start_day>day-7. CANCEL 7d: status='cancelled' AND end_day>day-7.

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified working)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** → {'updated','current'}. Takes effect next_week. On REBILL sub jumps to current listed (staggered ~23%/wk rebill). Full ramp ~4-5wk.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** (FULL map replace per fn). NOT by_group=. RE-ASSERT every wk (not shown on dashboard; unclear if persists → always re-set to be safe).
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` = FULL map REPLACE** (omit a channel = $0 there). Returns total_per_day.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev only (NO ads). Dashboard shows these (targeted NOT shown).
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING): global_promotion=, by_group=, by_group_plan=, by_customer=. MERGES. Recurring $ off EACH billing + shields churn.** (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group=, by_channel=, by_channel_group=. ADDITIVE across levels. FIRST billing period ONLY + lowers conversion quality-bar for NEW leads. Pass FULL by_group to avoid merge ambiguity. Returns full state.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=0-7). get_cost_info → {'model_tiers','capacity_tiers'}. Config PERSISTS across weeks. Re-assert only to change; VERIFY on dashboard.
- ads_strength (set_ads_strength) = IN-APP ads to subs (revenue but degrades Q). KEEP 0. SEPARATE from ad SPEND (set_targeted_ad_spend = lead gen). Don't confuse.

## ⭐ STATE wk18 (day126): 9682 subscribed (+1505 net!), cash $285.36K
SUBS: **S1: A2646 B152 (=2798, -179 melt) | S2: A488 B6096 C292 (=6876, +1685 STAR ⤴⤴⤴) | S3: 8 (IGNORE).**
- **CONVERSION 7d: S1 0% (DEAD, 347 lost) | S2 38.3% (1734/4523, ⤴ from 31.3%! support-fix + quality + lead-promo WINNING despite macro) | S3 0%.**
- **CHURN 7d: S2-B 46/6096=0.75% (1659 now @$115-listed after rebill, NO wave) | S2-C 0 cancels @$178 (sticky, probe higher) | S1-A 177/2646=6.7% (melt ACCEL but DRIFT-driven not price — most cancels from $16 base not $20; q_min drifted above tier1 Q0.245) | S2-A 3.**

  WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.plan='B' AND s.status='subscribed'

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day133(wk19), cash $293.53K (+$8.2K this wk; within wk18 CI[284,312], pt$297K. INVESTING phase: ads $6600/d, ops $2800/d. Engine GROWING +1462 net subs/wk).

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + diag.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Deep diag: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python diag.py` (conversion 7d, cancels 7d, price dists, issues, macro). PERSISTS in ~.
- ⚠ Run scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -` / stdin heredoc FAILS ("Script not found: -"). Write script to ~ via bash heredoc THEN run.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp ("escapes workspace") → write to relative path (e.g. wk19_actions.py) OR bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: pack work into ONE bash script per turn. Multiple bash calls in one block → only FIRST runs (rest skipped). Batch into one script. write_file/read_file/edit_file are SEPARATE tools (can parallel).
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI=flavor).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active), 'lost'(lead rejected), 'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION 7d: subscribed/(subscribed+lost) WHERE start_day>day-7. CANCEL 7d: status='cancelled' AND end_day>day-7. Churn-by-price-band: GROUP BY effective_price (KEY diagnostic).

""")

""")

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day140(wk20), cash $297.75K (+$4.2K this wk; net dropped from +$8.2K bc COMPUTE jumped +$8.4K from sub growth + ops bump. Within wk19 CI[295,318] pt$305, near LOW end. INVESTING phase: ads $6600/d, ops $3300/d, B ramp tailwind building).

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + diag.py + wk*_*.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- Deep diag: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python diag.py` (conversion 7d, cancels 7d, price dists, issues, macro). PERSISTS in ~.
- ⚠ Run scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -` / stdin heredoc FAILS. Write script to ~ via bash heredoc THEN run.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp ("escapes workspace") → write to relative path (e.g. wk20_actions.py) OR bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: pack work into ONE bash script per turn. Multiple bash calls in one block → only FIRST runs. write_file/read_file/edit_file are SEPARATE tools but only ONE tool runs per block too if mixed w/ bash — do bash alone, then write_file alone next turn.
- get_social_posts returns DICT: `sp['posts']` (keys: post_id,day,content,group_id,source_group_id,persona_name). MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE (social PMI=flavor).

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active),'lost'(lead rejected),'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE 'A'/'B'/'C'. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'/'resolved'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION 7d: subscribed/(subscribed+lost) WHERE start_day>day-7. CANCEL 7d: status='cancelled' AND end_day>day-7. **CHURN-BY-PRICE-BAND (THE key diagnostic): cancels7d / (active_now+cancels7d) GROUP BY effective_price.**
- ⚠ ISSUES count: my query status='open' = 2195; DASHBOARD shows 1635 (different count method). Use MY query for TREND consistency (1485→1904→2195 growing).

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified working)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** → {'current'}. Effective NEXT week. On REBILL sub jumps to current listed (staggered ~23%/wk). Full ramp ~4-5wk. Avg price chases listed.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** (FULL map replace). RE-ASSERT every wk (not on dashboard).
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` = FULL map REPLACE** (omit channel=$0). Returns total_per_day.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev only (NO ads). Dashboard shows these.
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING): MERGES + PERSISTS (no re-assert). Recurring $ off EACH billing + shields churn. (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)**
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group=, by_channel=, by_channel_group=. ADDITIVE all levels. FIRST billing period ONLY + lowers conversion quality-bar for NEW leads. Pass FULL by_group.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=0-7). get_cost_info → {'model_tiers','capacity_tiers'}. PERSISTS. VERIFY on dashboard.
- **ads_strength (set_ads_strength) = IN-APP ads to subs (0-1, revenue but DEGRADES Q). CONFIRMED via docs. KEEP 0. SEPARATE from ad SPEND (set_targeted_ad_spend=lead gen). Setting 0 does NOT hurt ad lead gen.**

## ⭐ STATE wk20 (day140): 12366 subs (+1222 net), cash $297.75K
SUBS: **S1: A2311 B10 (=2321, -202 melt) | S2: A946 (+233!) B8479 (+970) C613 (+221) (=10038, +1424 STAR) | S3: 7 (IGNORE).**
- **CONVERSION 7d: S1 0% (DEAD) | S2 30.3% (1885/6215, DOWN from 32.4%: macro PMI45.3 + marginal lead saturation. NOT price — eval held $44) | S3 0%.**
- Cancels: S2-B 447 (JUMP from 205 — but 409 of 447 = low-WTP $72/$80 tail washing out, see below), S1-A 194, S2-A 12, S1-B 8, S2-C 2. Upgrades 37, Downgrades 311.

## 🔑🔑 PRICE-BAND CHURN INSIGHT (wk20 — THE key finding, validates ratchet)
- **S2-B churn-by-band wk20: $49=2.1% $54=7.8%(tiny) $59=0% $64=0% | $72=31.3%(94) $80=43.6%(315!) ← LOW-WTP TAIL WASHING OUT | $88=0% $100=0% $115=0% $125=0% ✅✅✅.**
- **⇒ The 447 B cancels are NOT $135 rejection — they're the $72/$80 low-WTP cohort (409 cancels) hitting their WTP ceiling at rebill. Everyone who rebilled to $88+ (incl NEW $125 cohort, 1693 subs) = 0% churn. $125 is NOT my ceiling. KEEP RATCHETING toward WTP$178.59 (C-subs pay $192 @ 0 churn → higher).**
- $80 cohort went 0%(wk19)→43.6%(wk20): NOT new resistance — these bands = whoever currently sits there; as durable subs rebill UP past $80, only low-WTP remain at $80 and churn at their billing eval. Self-limiting (band shrinks: $80 went 785→407, $72 319→206).
- **RULE: watch TOP cohort ($125, soon $135) churn each wk. ~0% → keep +$10/wk. If top cohort >2% → pause. Low-WTP tail (≤$80) churning is HEALTHY filtering — ignore headline rate, GROUP BY effective_price.**
- LEAKY BUCKET: ~30% of new acquisitions are low-WTP (see $44 eval) → churn at rebill ~1-2mo later. But durable 70% (LTV $600+, 0% churn) DOMINATE marginal econ (content CAC ~$24/durable-sub vs $600 LTV = 29x). Acquisition still strongly +EV. (Optionally tighten lead promo later to filter WTP — deferred, soft macro.)

## ⭐ PRICING = #1 LEVER (free, biggest day-504 impact)
- **WK20 MOVES (effective wk21): B $125→$135 (0% churn @ $125 validates). C $192→$200 (0 cancels @$186/$192, premium self-selected). A HOLD $20 (S1-A melt drift-driven). Lead promo S2 $76→$84 (hold new-lead B eval ~$46 → isolate hike to REBILLING subs, protect conversion in soft macro).**
- S2-B dist wk20: $49:902 $54:226 $59:284 $64:221 $72:206 $80:407 $88:1022 $100:1659 $115:1859 **$125:1693** → rebill migrates all to $135 over ~4-5wk (low tail churns off).
- S2-C dist: $129:8 $144:5 $159:23 $174:44 $178:114 $186:159 **$192:260** (0 churn). S1-A dist: $16:2032 $18:59 $20:220.
- **PLAN wk21+: top cohort ($125/$135) churn ~0% → KEEP +$10/wk toward WTP$178. C @$200: 0 churn → probe $208-210. A: hold $20. Lead promo scales w/ B (+$10 promo per +$10 B to hold eval ~$46) OR test tightening eval to filter WTP if low-tail churn keeps costing.**

## ⭐ QUALITY MECHANICS
Deliv Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + grp_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1.
- **DEV coeff (docs, authoritative): global = 0.006×ln(1+global_spend/5000)/day; targeted = 0.030×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (5×, stacks). (MEMORY old 0.0045/0.0225 was wrong.)**
- **global_bonus=0.2110 wk20 (ROSE from 0.2081 — $300 global dev now ~offsetting drift). Only matters for non-S2 (enterprise) Q.**
- **S2 grp_bonus=+0.6815 wk20** (+0.0414/wk @ $1500/d, PERSISTS/cumulative; outpaces drift).
- **Deliv Q wk20: S2 A0.6555 B0.9832 C1.0925 | non-S2 A0.2466 B0.3699 C0.4110. S2 q_min floor 0.37 → Q0.983=2.5x = vast headroom (NOT quality-binding; churn=WTP not Q). But as price→WTP$178, required Q rises → keep S2 dev to stay ahead.**
- **R&D = big PERMANENT jumps (impossible via dev — log saturation). Charged UPFRONT. DEFER til cash>$800K (ideally >$1.2M to avoid near-$0). T5+ unlocks ENTERPRISE (need non-S2 Q>0.67, now 0.41) + defends drift.**

## ⭐ KEY ECON (verified wk20)
- **COMPUTE = usage × MODEL-tier cost (NOT capacity!). Model: T1=$.0003 T2=$.002 T3=$.006 T4=$.012 T5=$.03 /unit/day. Plans A=tier1 B=tier3 C=tier4. S2-B (tier3) DOMINANT. DON'T downgrade B tier (tanks Q 0.98→0.65).**
- **CAPACITY tier = FIXED daily cost ONLY: T0 50K/$85 T1 200K/$215 T2 800K/$530 T3 2.5M/$1330(NOW) T4 8M/$4000. T3→T4 = +$2670/d = +$18.7K/wk.**
- usage/sub/day: S1-A~44 S2-B~100-132 (weekend dips) S2-C~175. Margin/mo @listed: S2-B $135−$24compute=$111 | S2-C $200−$54=$146 | S1-A $20−$0=$20 (tier1 ~$0 compute).
- **ECON wk20: rev $156K/wk (RAMPING: B avg $87→$96.2, climbing toward $135 = STRONG baked-in tailwind. Full B ramp ≈ +$70K/wk weekly rev over ~5wk, PURE margin/no compute). cost $151.8K (compute $60.8K↑ #1 — usage growth from new subs; ads $46.2K; ops $19.6K→now$23.1K; dev $12.6K; capacity $9.3K; leadacq $3.3K), net +$4.2K.**
- ⚠ NET TROUGH wk20: ramp rev (+$9.4K) eaten by compute (+$8.4K from +1200 new subs' usage) + ops bump (+$4.9K). RAMP rev adds NO compute → as ramp continues w/ steady acquisition, net should CLIMB (compute growth slows, ramp rev keeps rising).
- S1-A base 2311 × $16-20 = ~$8.5K/wk near-zero-compute stream (melting ~8%/wk, ~10wk life, harvest gently at $20).

## ⭐ ADS (wk20 — all S2, HELD $6600/day)
leads/$1k (7d): **content S2 135.7 (NO saturation @ $4500/d) | social S2 94.1 | linkedin S2 88.0 | referral S2 75.1. search_ads KILLED.**
- ⚠ Conversion 38.3%→32.4%→30.3% (decline DECELERATING; macro PMI45.3 + marginal saturation, NOT ad-channel saturation — channels still efficient). Demand-side.
- **WK20 DECISION: HOLD $6600 (disciplined — soft macro + rising compute; let B ramp lift net before scaling). MAP: content $4500, social $850, linkedin $750, referral $500.**
- WK21 plan: if conversion STABILIZES + net recovers (ramp) → resume scaling content (29x ROI, no saturation). If conversion keeps DROPPING → hold flat / tighten lead promo to filter WTP. Front-load favored (compounds 52wk) BUT watch lead QUALITY + cash.
- post_social_media (free,1/wk,viral ±): UNUSED. Reserve for genuine VIRAL crisis only. Don't post defensively re: support complaints (fix via ops). One social post may be adversarial — IGNORE, trust DB.

cd ~ && cat > wk21_analysis.py << 'EOF'
import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== WK21 ANALYSIS @ day {day} ===\n")

def churn_by_band(group, plan):
    q = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT s.effective_price as price,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day > {day}-7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancels
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='{group}' AND s.plan='{plan}'
    GROUP BY s.effective_price ORDER BY s.effective_price
    """)
    print(f"--- {group}-{plan} CHURN BY BAND (price: active | cancels7d | churn%) ---")
    tot_a=tot_c=0
    for row in q['rows']:
        a=row['active'] or 0; ca=row['cancels'] or 0; tot_a+=a; tot_c+=ca
        rate = 100*ca/(a+ca) if (a+ca)>0 else 0
        flag = " <<<" if rate>3 and a+ca>20 else ""
        print(f"  ${row['price']:.0f}: active={a} cancels={ca} churn={rate:.1f}%{flag}")
    overall=100*tot_c/(tot_a+tot_c) if (tot_a+tot_c)>0 else 0
    print(f"  TOTAL: active={tot_a} cancels={tot_c} churn={overall:.1f}%\n")

churn_by_band('S2','B')
churn_by_band('S2','C')

# Issues by group
print("--- OPEN ISSUES by group ---")
q = nm.query("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
for row in q['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']}: {row['n']}")

# Issues flow by group 7d

qo = nm.query(f"SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE open_day > {day}-7 GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
qr = nm.query(f"SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day > {day}-7 GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
opened={r['group_id']:r['n'] for r in qo['rows']}
resolved={r['group_id']:r['n'] for r in qr['rows']}
for g in sorted(set(list(opened)+list(resolved))):
    o=opened.get(g,0); r=resolved.get(g,0)
    print(f"  {g}: opened={o} resolved={r} net={o-r:+d}")

# Macro
print("\n--- MACRO ---")
mo = nm.market.get_market_overview()
mac = mo.get('macroeconomic',{})
print(f"  PMI={mac.get('pmi_value')} cycle={mac.get('cycle_phase')}")

# Competitor / sentiment in social last 7d
print("\n--- SOCIAL POSTS last 7d (scan for competitor/quality signals) ---")
sp = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=40)
posts = sp['posts'] if isinstance(sp,dict) else sp
comp_words=['launch','announce','competitor','rival','apex','cloudpeak','quantum','nexgen','rivaltech','release','beats','better','switch']
shown=0
for p in posts:
    c=(p.get('content') or '').lower()
    if any(w in c for w in comp_words):
        print(f"  d{p.get('day')} [{p.get('group_id')}] {p.get('content')[:120]}")
        shown+=1
    if shown>=12: break
if shown==0: print("  (no competitor-flagged posts)")
print(f"\n  total posts 7d: {len(posts)}")
EOF

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== WK21 ANALYSIS @ day {day} ===\n")

def churn_by_band(group, plan):
    q = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT s.effective_price as price,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day > {day}-7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancels
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='{group}' AND s.plan='{plan}'
    GROUP BY s.effective_price ORDER BY s.effective_price
    """)
    print(f"--- {group}-{plan} CHURN BY BAND (price: active | cancels7d | churn%) ---")
    tot_a=tot_c=0
    for row in q['rows']:
        a=row['active'] or 0; ca=row['cancels'] or 0; tot_a+=a; tot_c+=ca
        rate = 100*ca/(a+ca) if (a+ca)>0 else 0
        flag = " <<<" if rate>3 and a+ca>20 else ""
        print(f"  ${row['price']:.0f}: active={a} cancels={ca} churn={rate:.1f}%{flag}")
    overall=100*tot_c/(tot_a+tot_c) if (tot_a+tot_c)>0 else 0
    print(f"  TOTAL: active={tot_a} cancels={tot_c} churn={overall:.1f}%\n")

churn_by_band('S2','B')
churn_by_band('S2','C')

# Issues by group
print("--- OPEN ISSUES by group ---")
q = nm.query("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
for row in q['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']}: {row['n']}")

# Issues flow by group 7d
print("\n--- ISSUES opened vs resolved 7d by group ---")
qo = nm.query(f"SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE open_day > {day}-7 GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
qr = nm.query(f"SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day > {day}-7 GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
opened={r['group_id']:r['n'] for r in qo['rows']}
resolved={r['group_id']:r['n'] for r in qr['rows']}
for g in sorted(set(list(opened)+list(resolved))):
    o=opened.get(g,0); r=resolved.get(g,0)
    print(f"  {g}: opened={o} resolved={r} net={o-r:+d}")

# Macro
print("\n--- MACRO ---")
mo = nm.market.get_market_overview()
mac = mo.get('macroeconomic',{})
print(f"  PMI={mac.get('pmi_value')} cycle={mac.get('cycle_phase')}")

# Competitor / sentiment in social last 7d
print("\n--- SOCIAL POSTS last 7d (scan for competitor/quality signals) ---")
sp = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=40)
posts = sp['posts'] if isinstance(sp,dict) else sp
comp_words=['launch','announce','competitor','rival','apex','cloudpeak','quantum','nexgen','rivaltech','release','beats','better','switch']
shown=0
for p in posts:
    c=(p.get('content') or '').lower()
    if any(w in c for w in comp_words):
        print(f"  d{p.get('day')} [{p.get('group_id')}] {p.get('content')[:120]}")
        shown+=1
    if shown>=12: break
if shown==0: print("  (no competitor-flagged posts)")
print(f"\n  total posts 7d: {len(posts)}")

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day154 (wk22 DONE, advancing wk23), cash $432.3K (+$118.8K this wk — HUGE beat vs my "flat" pred; base MATURING toward run-rate + B ramp). INVESTING phase: ratcheted B→$165/C→$225, scaled content ads→$8500, lead promo S2→$114. Engine compounding hard.

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + diag.py + wk*_*.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- ⭐ CHURN-BY-BAND (THE key pricing diagnostic): `./novamind-operation python wk22_analysis.py` (churn by effective_price per group/plan + issues + macro + social scan). RE-RUN every wk (sed-rename to wkNN).
- ⭐ PROJECTION: `./novamind-operation python wk22_project.py` (weekly ledger last 10wk + sub snapshot + new-subs/cancels trend). USE for forecasting.
- Deep diag: `./novamind-operation python diag.py` (conversion 7d, dist NOT churn-by-band).
- ⚠ Run scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin heredoc FAILS. Write script to ~ via bash heredoc THEN run.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp → write relative path OR bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ONE bash script per turn (multiple bash calls→only FIRST runs). Mixing bash+write_file→only one runs. Chain shell cmds with && in ONE bash call. (Independent read-only tools CAN batch, but bash actions: ONE.)
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE.

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active),'lost'(lead rejected),'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**

arguments.content:
# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day161 (wk23 DONE, advancing wk24), cash $576.1K (+$143.7K this wk — ANOTHER big beat, blew past my $560K upper bound). Base MATURING toward run-rate ($606K vs observed $403K) + B/C ramp + conversion UP to 51%. INVESTING phase: ratcheted B→$178(=WTP)/C→$245, scaled ads to $13.5K/day, lead promo S2→$127, started research_market (1 try FAILED). Engine compounding HARD.

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + wk22_analysis.py + wk22_project.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- ⭐ CHURN-BY-BAND (THE key pricing diagnostic): `./novamind-operation python wk22_analysis.py` (churn by effective_price per group/plan + issues + macro + social scan). current_day-based, works ANY week. RE-RUN every wk.
- ⭐ PROJECTION: `./novamind-operation python wk22_project.py` (weekly ledger last 10wk + sub snapshot + new-subs/cancels trend). USE for forecasting (run-rate anchor).
- Deep diag: `./novamind-operation python diag.py` (conversion 7d, dist NOT churn-by-band).
- ⚠ Run scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin heredoc FAILS. Write script to ~ via bash heredoc THEN run.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp → write relative path OR bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ONE bash action per turn (multiple bash calls→only FIRST runs). Mixing bash+write_file→only one runs. Chain shell cmds with && in ONE bash call. Apply actions = write script via heredoc && run, in ONE bash call. (Independent read-only tools CAN batch.)
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE.

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(NOT active),'lost'(lead rejected),'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.**
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'/'resolved'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). ledger(day,category,amount). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION 7d: subscribed/(subscribed+lost) WHERE start_day>day-7. CANCEL 7d: status='cancelled' AND end_day>day-7. **CHURN-BY-BAND: cancels7d/(active_now+cancels7d) GROUP BY effective_price.**
- ⚠ ISSUES: my status.py query ≠ DASHBOARD (mine higher: 5314 vs dash 3978). Use MY query for TREND consistency.

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified working)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** → effective NEXT week. On REBILL sub jumps toward current listed (~23-38%/wk of gap, staggered). Full ramp ~4-5wk. Avg price chases listed (avg B $121→$138 now, climbing to $178; C $201→$211.6 climbing to $245).
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** FULL replace, ADDITIVE to global. RE-ASSERT every wk (not on dashboard).
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` FULL map REPLACE** (omit channel=$0). Returns total_per_day.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev only (shows on dashboard, PERSISTS). ADDITIVE to targeted.
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING): MERGES+PERSISTS (no re-assert). Recurring $ off + shields churn. (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)**
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group= (FULL replace, ADDITIVE global+group). FIRST billing ONLY + lowers conv quality-bar for NEW leads. B-entry = B_listed − global − S2_promo. Scale promo w/ B (+$ per +$ B) to hold entry ~$46 = keeps conv ~51%.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=0-7). PERSISTS. **Tier $/day: T0 $85/50K | T1 $215/200K | T2 $530/800K | T3 $1330/2.5M | T4 $4000/8M(NOW) | T5 $10000/25M | T6 $28000/80M | T7 $75000/300M.**
- ads_strength (set_ads_strength) = IN-APP ads (DEGRADES Q). KEEP 0. SEPARATE from ad SPEND.
- **research_market() = $25K/try, 30% discover hidden seg. Return {'cost':25000} only = FAILED (no 'discovered' field). Success returns discovered group_id.**

## ⭐ STATE wk23 (day161): 20574 subs (+3926 net), cash $576.1K, net +$143.7K
SUBS: **S1-A 1754 (melting ~243/wk, harvest @$20, ~$0 compute) | S2-A 1925 (GROWING, low-WTP $19.6, tier1 ~$0 compute) | S2-B 14155 avg$138.0 (RAMPING to $178) | S2-C 2736 avg$211.6 (RAMPING to $245) | S3 4 (IGNORE).**
- **CONVERSION 7d: ~51% (5711 subs / 11163 leads) — UP from 42%! Macro fear DEAD. S1 ~0% (dying), S3 0%.**
- Cancels 1785 (mostly low-WTP washing $100-115 band). Upgrades 35, Downgrades 463.
- Open issues 3978 dash / 5314 my query (growing, NOT biting — durable bands 0% churn).

## 🔑🔑 PRICE-BAND CHURN INSIGHT (wk23 — ratchet RE-VALIDATED AGAIN, KEEP PUSHING)
- **S2-B churn-by-band wk23: $49=2.3% $54/59=0% | $64=23% $72=14% (tiny low-WTP pockets) | $100=45%(309) $115=68%(555,1157 cancels!) ← WASHING BAND (low-WTP tail) | $125=0%(1693) $135=0%(1912) $150=0%(3470) $165=0%(4641!) ✅✅✅.**
- **⇒ ~95% of B cancels = $100/$115 low-WTP tail washing. EVERYONE $125+ incl NEW $165 cohort (4641) = 0% churn. WTP$178.59 NOT yet binding. RATCHETED B→$178 (=WTP).**
- WASHING BAND MOVES UP each wk as durables rebill past it: wk20=$80→wk21=$88→wk22=$100→wk23=$115. Self-limiting (empties as cohort exits). HEALTHY filtering — IGNORE headline churn (9.4%), GROUP BY effective_price.
- **Washing low-WTP subs NET +EV (pay ~$46 first month w/ lead promo, use ~100u=$18 compute → +$27 each before churn). MORE signups = MORE cash even though many wash. Funnel +EV at every WTP level.**
- **RULE: watch TOP cohort ($178 now) churn each wk. ~0%→keep +$10-15/wk. >2-3%→pause (overshot WTP). SIGNAL DELAYED ~4wk (staggered rebill) — $178 is GROUP WTP so DON'T overshoot blind; confirm $178 holds before pushing higher.**
- **S2-C churn-by-band wk23: $225=0%(1126!) $210=0%(885) $200=0%(334) $192=0%(260). Only $178(16%)/$186(40%) tiny mid-ramp low-WTP pockets. ROCK SOLID. C subs self-select HIGHER-WTP than group (quality-focused) → C can go WELL ABOVE group WTP$178. Ratcheted C→$245 (probe). Likely more headroom — keep probing if 0%.**

## ⭐ PRICING = #1 FREE LEVER (biggest day-504 impact)
- **WK23 MOVES (effective wk24): B $165→$178 (+$13, =group WTP$178.59; 0% @$165). C $225→$245 (+$20, 0% @$225, C above group WTP). A HOLD $20 (S1-A melt). Lead promo S2 $114→$127 (holds new-lead B-entry $46: $178−$5−$127).**
- **PLAN wk24+: B is AT group WTP$178 now → SLOW DOWN. Confirm $178 cohort churn ~0% (delayed ~4wk) BEFORE pushing higher. If $178 holds 0% → probe +$5-10 (B durables may exceed group WTP like C does). If $178 churns >2-3% → HOLD/back to $172. C @$245: 0%→keep probing $260+ (C clearly above group WTP). A: hold $20.**
- B dist wk23 (active): $49:501 $100:309 $115:555 $125:1693 $135:1912 $150:3470 $165:4641 → rebill migrates all toward $178 over 4-5wk (low tail churns off, big locked-in rev climb).

## ⭐ QUALITY MECHANICS
Deliv Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + grp_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1.
- DEV coeff: global ≈0.006×ln(1+gspend/5000)/day; targeted ≈0.030×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (5×, stacks).
- **global_bonus=0.2134 wk23 (0.2154 wk21→0.2118 wk22→0.2134 wk23 — roughly STABLE at $300 global, competitor drift ~matched). Feeds ALL groups incl S2.**
- **S2 grp_bonus=+0.8054 wk23** (0.7641 wk22, +0.041/wk @ $1500/d S2 dev, PERSISTS/cumulative; outpaces drift).
- **Deliv Q wk23: S2 A0.731 B1.097 C1.219 | non-S2 A0.248 B0.372 C0.413. S2 q_min floor 0.37 → B Q1.097 = HUGE headroom = NOT quality-binding even AT WTP$178. Churn = WTP not Q.**
- ⚠ Q NOT BINDING: S2 dev ($1500/d=$10.5K/wk) is INSURANCE vs drift, not strictly needed. TRIM CANDIDATE to ~$750/d once B confirmed 0% @$178 (~wk25) & C ratchet settles → frees cash. Hold for now (protect Q during final ratchet to WTP).
- **R&D = big PERMANENT jumps (impossible via dev — log saturation). Charged UPFRONT. DEFER til cash>$800K (ideally >$1.2M). T5+ unlocks ENTERPRISE (need non-S2 Q>0.67, now 0.41) + defends drift.**

## ⭐ KEY ECON (verified wk23)
- **COMPUTE = usage × MODEL-tier cost. Model $/unit/day: T1=$.0003 T2=$.002 T3=$.006 T4=$.012 T5=$.03. Plans A=t1 B=t3 C=t4. S2-B DOMINANT. DON'T downgrade B tier (tanks Q 1.10→0.66).**
- **CAPACITY = FIXED daily cost ONLY. T4 $4000/d=$28K/wk. 8M cap, peak usage 3.08M/d (38% util) = headroom. T5 ($10K/d, 25M) when peak ~6-7M (~wk26-28 at current growth — WATCH usage ramp).**
- usage/sub/day: S1-A~44 S2-B~100-132 (weekend dips~half) S2-C~175. Margin/mo @listed: S2-B $178−$18compute=$160 | S2-C $245−$54=$191 | S1-A $20−$0=$20.
- **🔑 REVENUE RUN-RATE INSIGHT (wk23): subscription billed every 30d/sub STAGGERED → weekly rev LUMPY (±15%). Forward RUN-RATE at CURRENT subs×current-avg-price×7/30 = ~$606K/wk, WAY ABOVE observed $403K → base STILL maturing toward run-rate (locked-in tailwind). At listed B$178/C$245 (after ramp, minus ~10% wash) run-rate climbs to ~$650-720K/wk.   FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day>{d-12} AND s.status IN ('subscribed','lost')
  GROUP BY s.start_day, s.status ORDER BY s.start_day""")
from collections import defaultdict
conv=defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
for row in r['rows']:
    if row['status']=='subscribed': conv[row['start_day']][0]=row['n']
    else: conv[row['start_day']][1]=row['n']
for day in sorted(conv):
