# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day182 (wk26 DONE, advancing wk27), cash $764.95K (−$41.3K this wk — FIRST NEGATIVE week: rev TROUGH $398.9K (3rd straight decline $518→$457→$399) + compute SPIKE $236.2K (#1 cost, +13%/wk) + ops bump $46.2K (+$17K from $5000 S2 bump). 34948 subs (+2188 net, 4915 cancels). My wk25 1wk pred $870K MISSED HIGH again (actual $765K, BELOW lower bound — 2nd over-predict in a row, see FORECASTING). 🔴🔴 BIG REVENUE-MODEL CORRECTION this wk — my old $1.37M MRR run-rate was WRONG. See REVENUE/BILLING MODEL below. INVESTING: held B$190 (gather 2nd-bill data), pushed C→$285, held ads/ops/dev, HELD T4 (save $42K, go T5 next wk if peak>7M).

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST (HOME=agent_workspace w/ novamind-operation + MEMORY.md + status.py + wk22_analysis.py + wk22_project.py + wk26_diag.py + wk26_recon.py + wk26_notes.py + apply_wk26.py). Decoy at run-ceobench (NOT my session).
- Status: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger 7d+lifetime, subs, ad leads/$1k, service, issues, threads).
- ⭐ CHURN-BY-BAND: `./novamind-operation python wk22_analysis.py` (churn by effective_price per group/plan + issues + macro + social scan). RE-RUN every wk. ⚠ See 2nd-BILL CAVEAT below — fresh high bands show 0% only because they HAVEN'T hit 2nd-bill yet!
- ⭐ PROJECTION: `./novamind-operation python wk22_project.py` (weekly ledger last 10wk + sub snapshot + new-subs/cancels trend). USE for forecasting.
- ⭐ REVENUE RECON: `./novamind-operation python wk26_recon.py` (payment-amount bands) + `wk26_notes.py` (payment notes + effective_price-by-tenure). RE-RUN to confirm billing mix.
- ⭐ DIAG: `./novamind-operation python wk26_diag.py` (payment-by-day, conversion-by-day, compute-by-day, peak usage, S2 group insights, macro). KEY for conversion/capacity/reputation.
- ⚠ Run scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin heredoc FAILS. Write script to ~ via bash heredoc THEN run.
- ⚠ write_file BLOCKS /tmp → write relative path OR bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecast numbers>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ONE bash action per turn (multiple bash calls→only FIRST runs). Chain shell cmds with && in ONE bash call. Apply actions = write script via heredoc && run, in ONE bash call. (Independent read-only tools CAN batch.) MEMORY update: ONE write_file, separate turn from next-week.
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE.

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id → JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'(active),'lost'(lead rejected at arrival),'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- **ledger: cols id,day,category,amount,note. NO customer_id col (note has "...from customer NNNNN" text). Can't easily join payments→customers.**
- enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col! Open=closed=0. Cols: message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'/'resolved'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- CONVERSION: subscribed/(subscribed+lost) WHERE start_day in window. CHURN-BY-BAND: cancels7d/(active_now+cancels7d) GROUP BY effective_price (BUT see 2nd-bill caveat).

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified working)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** → effective the UPCOMING wk. ⚠⚠ **GRANDFATHERED model: effective_price ≈ LISTED PRICE AT SIGNUP, locked per-customer, ramps only slowly/little. Raising listed price affects ONLY NEW signups (lock at new price); existing subs keep their old (lower) price.** Confirmed: effective_price by tenure 0-2wk=$187, 2-4wk=$171, 1-2mo=$132, 3mo+=$78 (OLD subs LOW = signed up when listed was low + survivorship). So price hikes grow revenue via NEW high-WTP signups, NOT existing base.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** FULL replace, ADDITIVE to global. RE-ASSERT every wk.
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` FULL map REPLACE** (omit channel=$0). Returns total_per_day. RE-ASSERT every wk.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev only (dashboard, PERSISTS). ADDITIVE to targeted.
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING): MERGES+PERSISTS. Recurring $ off + shields churn. (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)**
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group= (FULL replace, ADDITIVE). ⚠ FIRST BILLING PERIOD ONLY (confirmed docs) + lowers conv quality-bar. Per-GROUP (applies to all plans of that group). B-entry=B_listed−global−S2_promo=$46. C-entry=C_listed−$144=$141. Subsequent bills use effective_price (no lead promo).**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=0-7). PERSISTS. Tier $/day: T0 $85/50K | T1 $215/200K | T2 $530/800K | T3 $1330/2.5M | T4 $4000/8M(NOW) | T5 $10000/25M | T6 $28000/80M | T7 $75000/300M.
- ads_strength (set_ads_strength) = IN-APP ads (DEGRADES Q). KEEP 0. SEPARATE from ad SPEND.
- research_market() = $25K/try, 30% discover hidden seg. Return {'cost':25000} only = FAILED.

## 🔴🔴 REVENUE / BILLING MODEL (BIG wk26 CORRECTION — old $1.37M MRR run-rate was WRONG)
- **Billing: every 30d/customer. FIRST bill = entry price (lead promo applied) = ~$46 for S2-B. From 2nd bill onward = effective_price (locked at signup ≈ listed-then), NO lead promo.**
- **wk26 payment mix (7d): 86% of payments ($308K/$399K) are at $30-60 = $46 FIRST-bills. Only 115 payments at $150-200 (durable 2nd+ bills). Avg payment ~$52, STABLE 18 days. ⇒ revenue is DOMINATED by $46 first-bills, NOT the $176 effective_price.**
- **🔑 WASHING happens AT the 2nd-bill evaluation (~30d post-signup), NOT continuously. A new cohort signs up at effective $185-190, pays $46 first bill (0% churn while on 1st bill), then at d+30 hits billing eval: those with WTP<effective_price CHURN, those above survive & pay full price. So "0% churn" on FRESH high bands ($178/$185/$190) is MEANINGLESS — they just haven't hit 2nd bill yet.**
- **🔑 SURVIVAL ~20-25% (from $150 band: 856 survive/3469=25%). Acquired pool is LOW-WTP-SKEWED (the $46 entry attracts many low-WTP who'd never pay $150+; that's why even $150<mean-WTP$178 washes 75%). Only high-WTP minority survives 2nd bill → becomes durable.**
- **⇒ REAL revenue = first_bills ($46 × new-subs-billing, lagged ~30d) + durable_recurring (accumulating, ~$80K/wk now, GROWING as survivors stack). NOT MRR-of-effective-price. Revenue grows with the DURABLE BASE, slower than I'd assumed.**
- **2nd-BILL WAVES (lumpy + churn spikes): cohort signs up wk N → 2nd bill wk N+4ish. Big cohorts d154(4251)/d161(5711) hit 2nd bill d184-191 (NEXT WK) → revenue bump (survivors lock $150-165) + CANCEL SPIKE (washers, expect 6-9K cancels). d168(8338)/d175(8090)/d182(7103)=23.5K hit 2nd bill d196-212 → bigger wave.**
- **DURABLE ECON: durable pays ~$180/mo, ~$25/mo compute → ~$35/wk net each, persists many months (3mo+ survivors still paying). ~1400 durables/wk added (7000 new × 20%) → +$49K/wk NEW recurring stacking. WASHER ECON: +$46 first bill − $18 compute − $15 ad CAC − $0.5 = +$12.5 each, marginally +EV (PLUS reputation damage on cancel — see below).**

## ⭐ STATE wk26 (day182): 34948 subs (+2188 net), cash $764.95K, NET −$41.3K
SUBS: **S1-A 1012 (melting, harvest @$16.6, ~$0 compute) | S2-A 2385 (low-WTP $19.7, tier1 ~$0 compute) | S2-B 27889 effective avg$176.2 (mostly 1st-bill $46 cohorts) | S2-C 3660 avg$242.1 | S3 2 (IGNORE).**
- **CONVERSION: 41% weekly (7103/17170) BUT RECOVERING by day: d172=33%→d182=45% (was 59-67% pre-dip). Dip d172-176 = transient (d171 outage + competitor launch wave d171-174). NOT saturation (S2 only 20% penetrated). Reputation healing → conversion climbing. WATCH it recover toward 50%+.**
- Cancels 4915 (UP from 2452 — washing accelerating as cohorts hit 2nd bill). Will SPIKE more d184-212.
- Open issues 16740 (DOWN from 17846 — ops $5000 DRAINING, net −1157/wk: opened 26209 < resolved 27366). S2 14885.

## 🔑 PRICE-BAND CHURN — 2nd-BILL CAVEAT (wk26 revised)
- S2-B bands wk26: $150=75.3%(856act/2613canc ← WASHING BAND now, was $135 last wk) | $165=0%(4641) $178=0%(7229) $185=0%(7346) $190=0%(6745). C bands: $210=74.5%(washing) | $225/$245/$260/$275 all 0%.
- **⚠ The 0% on $165-190 (B) and $225-275 (C) is NOT validated tolerance — these are FRESH cohorts on 1st bill ($46). They'll wash at THEIR 2nd bill (d+30). The washing band ($150 B / $210 C) IS the 2nd-bill cohort revealing true survival (~25%).**
- WASHING BAND MOVES UP each wk as cohorts age into 2nd bill: $88→$100→$115→$125→$135→$150(now). Self-limiting per-cohort but each new cohort feeds it.
- **⇒ PRICING SIGNAL is delayed ~4wk (until cohort hits 2nd bill). To judge if B$190 is too high, watch the $185/$190 bands' churn in ~2-3 wk (d196-210) when those cohorts hit 2nd bill. If they wash heavily (like $150 does) → $190 near/above ceiling. If they survive better than $150 → room to push.**
- HEADLINE churn (11.3% B / 16.5% C) MISLEADS (washing). GROUP BY effective_price AND remember fresh bands unvalidated.

## ⭐ PRICING = #1 FREE LEVER (but grandfathered — affects NEW signups only)
- **WK26 MOVES (effective wk27): B HOLD $190 (above est mean WTP$178.59; acquired pool low-WTP-skewed; gather 2nd-bill data on $185/$190 cohorts d196-210 before pushing). C $275→$285 (+$10, high-WTP self-selection, ceiling-find, low risk). A HOLD $20. Lead promo S2 $139 held (B-entry $46).**
- **PLAN wk27+: WAIT for $185/$190 B 2nd-bill data (d196-210). If survive decently → push B +$5-10. If wash heavily → $190 is ceiling, HOLD. C: if $260/$275 survive 2nd bill (d196+) → keep probing $295+. CAUTION: grandfather means hikes only help NEW signups; don't overshoot & shrink survivor pool.**
- **CANDIDATE OPTIMIZATION (test soon): RAISE ENTRY price (cut lead promo) to filter deep-washers (WTP<~$70) at the door → fewer cancellations (less reputation damage), less compute waste, higher first-bill rev, BUT lower conversion & fewer durables. Held this wk to keep funnel constant & read 2nd-bill waves cleanly. Decide wk27-28.**

## ⭐ QUALITY MECHANICS
Deliv Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + grp_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1.
- **global_bonus=0.2139 wk26 (0.2184 wk25, slight DOWN — competitor drift slightly outpacing $300 global dev). Feeds ALL groups.**
- **S2 grp_bonus=+0.9294 wk26** (0.8881 wk25, +0.041/wk @ $1500/d S2 dev, PERSISTS/cumulative; outpaces drift).
- **Deliv Q wk26: S2 A0.806 B1.209 C1.343 | non-S2 A0.248 B0.373 C0.414. S2 q_min floor 0.37 → B Q1.209 = HUGE headroom = NOT quality-binding. Churn = WTP not Q.**
- ⚠ Q NOT BINDING for S2: dev ($1500/d) is INSURANCE vs drift + supports high pricing. TRIM CANDIDATE to ~$750/d once cash recovers + B confirmed. HOLD for now.

SELECT (start_day/7)*7 as cohort_wk, status, COUNT(*) as n, ROUND(AVG(effective_price),0) as avgp

GROUP BY cohort_wk, status ORDER BY cohort_wk
"""

print(f"{'cohort_day':>10} {'subbed':>8} {'cancel':>8} {'lost':>8} {'surv%':>7} {'sub_avgp':>9}")

CUT B$190→$150, C$285→$230 (grandfathered=no near-term hit), mild entry raise $46→$60. See SURVIVAL-ELASTICITY below. Issues GROWING (+3451/wk, washing-driven).

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST. Files: novamind-operation, MEMORY.md, status.py, wk22_analysis.py, wk22_project.py, wk26_diag.py, wk26_recon.py, wk26_notes.py, wk27_cohort.py, apply_wk27.py.
- Status: `./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger 7d+lifetime, subs, ad leads/$1k, service peak, issues, threads).
- ⭐ COHORT SURVIVAL (NEW, KEY): `./novamind-operation python wk27_cohort.py` — S2-B & S2-C 2nd-bill survival BY SIGNUP-WEEK & locked price. RE-RUN every wk. THE key pricing/forecasting signal.
- ⭐ PROJECTION: `./novamind-operation python wk22_project.py` (weekly ledger last 10wk + sub snapshot + new-subs/cancels). USE for forecasting.
- ⭐ REVENUE RECON: `./novamind-operation python wk26_recon.py` (payment bands) + `wk26_notes.py` (payment notes + effective_price-by-TENURE).
- ⭐ CHURN-BY-BAND + ISSUES + MACRO + SOCIAL: `./novamind-operation python wk22_analysis.py 2>/dev/null | head -80`. ⚠ band-churn% CONFOUNDED by cohort age (older bands fully-washed→high churn%). Use wk27_cohort.py for clean signal.
- ⭐ DIAG: `./novamind-operation python wk26_diag.py` (payment/conversion/compute by day, peak usage, S2 insights, macro).
- ⚠ Scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin FAILS. write_file BLOCKS /tmp → relative path or bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecasts>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ONE bash action/turn (multiple→only FIRST runs). Chain with && in ONE call. Apply=heredoc write && run in ONE call. MEMORY=ONE write_file, separate turn from next-week. (Independent read-only tools CAN batch.)
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']['pmi_value']/['cycle_phase']` AUTHORITATIVE.

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id→JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'/'lost'(lead rejected@arrival)/'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. Bad enum→EMPTY silently.
- ledger: cols id,day,category,amount,note. NO customer_id (note text "...from customer NNNNN").
- enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col. Open=closed=0. message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'/'resolved'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- ⚠ ISSUE COUNT: dashboard "Open Issues" (12500) ≠ query status='open' (20247). Use QUERY for trend (opened vs resolved). wk27: opened 30902 > resolved 27451 = backlog GROWING +3451/wk.

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** → effective UPCOMING wk. ⚠⚠ **GRANDFATHERED: effective_price ≈ LISTED PRICE AT SIGNUP, locked per-customer, ramps slowly/little. Listed-price change affects ONLY NEW signups; existing subs keep old locked price.** Confirmed by tenure: 0-2wk=$190, 2-4wk=$180, 1-2mo=$153, 2-3mo=$120, 3mo+=$87 (old subs LOW = signed when listed low + survivorship). So CUTTING listed price = no near-term revenue hit (existing grandfathered), only changes NEW cohorts' locked price → their 2nd-bill survival.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** FULL replace, ADDITIVE to global. RE-ASSERT every wk.
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$}}` FULL map REPLACE** (omit=$0). Returns total_per_day. RE-ASSERT every wk.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev (PERSISTS). ADDITIVE to targeted.
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING): MERGES+PERSISTS. Recurring $ off + shields churn. (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)** ≠ lead promo.
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group= (FULL replace, ADDITIVE, per-GROUP=all plans of that grp). ⚠ FIRST BILLING PERIOD ONLY + lowers conv quality-bar. Entry = listed − global − grp_promo. Subsequent bills = effective_price (NO lead promo).**

## 🔴🔴 SURVIVAL-vs-PRICE ELASTICITY (wk27 cohort analysis — THE KEY FINDING)

So WTP-elasticity real but partly confounded.**

Narrowing the gap (lower locked + higher entry, toward entry≈locked) → less washing, fewer issues, higher survival, higher first-bill/sub, BUT lower conversion volume. KEY FUTURE LEVER.**

INFLECTION = when big cohorts (d161-d189, each ~9-10K) hit 2nd bill (d191-220) → survivors (~7-15%) stack → durable base grows ~900-1500/wk → durable recurring climbs.**

import novamind_api as nm

TIERCOST = {1: 0.0003, 2: 0.002, 3: 0.006, 4: 0.012, 5: 0.018}
CUR_TIER = {'A': 1, 'B': 2, 'C': 4}

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

print("=== LEDGER compute last 7d (ground truth) ===")
r = q("SELECT SUM(amount) s, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE category='compute' AND day BETWEEN 197 AND 203")
print(f"  total compute = ${-r[0]['s']:,.0f}  ({r[0]['n']} rows)")

print("\n=== PER-PLAN usage last 7d (join to CURRENT subscribed plan) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT s.plan p, COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) users, SUM(du.usage_units) usage
            FROM daily_usage du JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=du.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
            WHERE du.day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 GROUP BY s.plan""")
tot_calc = 0
for x in rows:
    p = x['p']
    t = CUR_TIER.get(p, 2)
    comp = x['usage'] * TIERCOST[t]
    tot_calc += comp
    print(f"  Plan {p} (tier{t}): users={x['users']} usage={x['usage']:,.0f} compute=${comp:,.0f}")
print(f"  TOTAL calc (active only) = ${tot_calc:,.0f}  (ledger includes mid-week-cancel usage too)")

print("\n=== PROPOSED TIER CUTS (per-plan, using active usage) ===")
for x in rows:
    p = x['p']
    if p == 'B':
        cur = x['usage']*TIERCOST[2]; new = x['usage']*TIERCOST[1]
        print(f"  B tier2->1: ${cur:,.0f} -> ${new:,.0f}  SAVE ${cur-new:,.0f}/wk (Q 1.105->0.884)")
    if p == 'C':
        cur = x['usage']*TIERCOST[4]; new3 = x['usage']*TIERCOST[3]
        print(f"  C tier4->3: ${cur:,.0f} -> ${new3:,.0f}  SAVE ${cur-new3:,.0f}/wk (Q 1.474->1.327)")

print("\n=== mid-week-cancel usage (had usage but no active sub now) ===")
r = q("""SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) n, SUM(du.usage_units) usage FROM daily_usage du
         WHERE du.day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 AND du.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed')""")
print(f"  n={r[0]['n']} usage={r[0]['usage'] or 0:,.0f}")

print("\n=== CONVERSION BY DAY (leads arriving vs subscribed, by start_day) ===")
# subscribed rows starting each day = converted; lost rows starting each day = rejected
rows = q("""SELECT start_day d,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status!='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subbed,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost
            FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 185 AND 203 GROUP BY start_day ORDER BY start_day""")
for x in rows:
    tot = x['subbed'] + x['lost']
    conv = 100.0*x['subbed']/tot if tot else 0
    print(f"  d{x['d']}: subbed={x['subbed']:5d} lost={x['lost']:5d} conv={conv:4.0f}%")

print("\n=== NEW SUBS BY PLAN last 7d (start_day 197-203, not lost) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) ap FROM subscriptions
            WHERE start_day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 AND status!='lost' GROUP BY plan""")
for x in rows:
    print(f"  Plan {x['plan']}: {x['n']} new, avg_eff_price=${x['ap']:.0f}")

- **⇒ C IS NOW THE FUNNEL. PROTECT C TIER 4 (Q 1.474). 🔴 LESSON (learned THIS wk with B): dropping the FUNNEL plan's tier CRATERS conversion. So: keep C tier4. B is NOT funnel → safe to cut B tier (did → tier1).**
- **C-mill per-washer econ: +$126 first-bill − ~$43 compute(C tier4, ~30d) − $40 CAC − $0.5 onboard ≈ +$42/C-washer. ×2614/wk = strong. Survivors (C durables @ $224) = bonus.**
- **⭐ C compute is now $40K/wk (tier4, $0.012/unit, 3961 active C). TEMPTING to cut C tier4→3 (save $20K/wk, Q 1.474→1.327). RISK: C is funnel — could crater C conversion (the B lesson). BUT C-converters are HIGH-WTP (low p/w at $126 → low quality bar → 1.327 likely still clears). UNCERTAIN. Decided: HOLD C tier4 wk29, TEST C tier3 wk30 with clean data + watch C conversion HARD.**

HELD ads wk29 to validate C-mill cleanly. wk30: if C-mill stable → SCALE ADS aggressively (watch capacity toward 8M → T5).**

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST. Files: novamind-operation, MEMORY.md, status.py, wk29_diag.py, wk29_promo.py, wk29_apply.py, wk28_compute.py, wk27_cohort.py, wk22_project.py, wk26_diag.py, wk26_recon.py, wk22_analysis.py.

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id→JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'/'lost'(lead rejected@arrival)/'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price/listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count. ⚠ effective_price = LISTED price for NEW subs (entry discount NOT stored here — it's applied at billing). - **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group= (FULL replace, PERSISTS across wks — verified C entry stayed $126. ADDITIVE: global+grp stack. per-GROUP=all plans). ⚠ FIRST BILL ONLY + lowers conv quality-bar. Entry = listed − global − grp. 2nd+ = effective_price (NO lead promo). NOW global $5 + S2 $99 → entry A~$0, B=$46, C=$126.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=0-7). PERSISTS fixed $/day. T0 $85/50K|T1 $215/200K|T2 $530/800K|T3 $1330/2.5M|T4 $4000/8M(NOW)|T5 $10000/25M|T6 $28000/80M|T7 $75000/300M.

## 🔴 PRICING/CONVERSION MECHANICS (refined wk29)

import novamind_api as nm
D = nm.vars.current_day
lo, hi = D-6, D   # this week's 7 simulated days
print(f"=== current_day={D}, week window days {lo}-{hi} ===")

# 1. Compute by plan this week (ledger ground truth total)
r = nm.query(f"SELECT SUM(amount) s, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE category='compute' AND day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}")
print(f"\n[1] LEDGER compute this week total = ${-r['rows'][0]['s']:,.0f} ({r['rows'][0]['n']} rows)")

# per-plan active usage this week
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT s.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) users, SUM(du.usage_units) u
FROM daily_usage du JOIN subscriptions s ON du.customer_id=s.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
WHERE du.day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} GROUP BY s.plan""")
tiercost={'A':0.0003,'B':0.0003,'C':0.012}  # current tiers A=1 B=1 C=4
tot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    p=row['plan']; c=row['u']*tiercost[p]; tot+=c
    print(f"  Plan {p}: users={row['users']} usage={row['u']:,} compute=${c:,.0f}")
print(f"  TOTAL active-only calc = ${tot:,.0f}")

# mid-week-cancel usage (used compute but not active now) by what tier they'd be
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT SUM(du.usage_units) u, COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) n
FROM daily_usage du
WHERE du.day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
AND du.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed')""")
print(f"  mid-week-cancel usage: n={r['rows'][0]['n']} usage={r['rows'][0]['u']:,}")

# 2. New subs by plan this week
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) ap
FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} AND status!='lost'
GROUP BY plan""")
print(f"\n[2] NEW SUBS this week (start_day {lo}-{hi}, subscribed):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  Plan {row['plan']}: {row['n']} new, avg_listed=${row['ap']:.0f}")

# 3. Conversion last 14 days
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT start_day, SUM(CASE WHEN status!='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sub, SUM(CASE WHEN status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost
FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN {D-13} AND {D} GROUP BY start_day ORDER BY start_day""")
print(f"\n[3] CONVERSION BY DAY (last 14d):")
for row in r['rows']:
    tot_l=row['sub']+row['lost']; conv=100*row['sub']/tot_l if tot_l else 0
    print(f"  d{row['start_day']}: sub={row['sub']:5} lost={row['lost']:5} conv={conv:4.0f}%")

# 4. DURABLE BASE (start_day < D-35, still subscribed) = recurring engine
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) ap
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day < {D-35}
GROUP BY s.plan""")
print(f"\n[4] DURABLE BASE (start_day < {D-35}, subscribed):")
durtot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    mo=row['n']*row['ap']; durtot+=mo
    print(f"  Plan {row['plan']}: {row['n']} durables, avg_eff=${row['ap']:.0f}  monthly=${mo:,.0f}")
print(f"  TOTAL durable monthly recurring (listed) = ${durtot:,.0f}  (~${durtot/4.33:,.0f}/wk)")

# 5. Payment buckets this week (ground truth on what subs PAY)
r = nm.query(f"""

FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket""")

for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  ${row['bucket']}-{row['bucket']+9}: {row['n']:5} payments, ${row['tot']:,.0f}")
EOF

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day210 (wk30 DONE, advancing wk31), cash $760.85K (🟢 +$51.85K this wk — within forecast CI, near low end; net cooling +$94K→+$52K as washing wave tapers + base shrinks). WK30 BIG MOVE: dropped C tier 4→3 (C compute had BALLOONED $35K→$72.6K as C-mill ramps — now #1 cost; tier3 saves ~$32-36K/wk + relieves future capacity + boosts C-mill margin/washer $26.6→$52.3). Held ads/ops/dev for CLEAN measurement of C tier3 conversion effect → SCALE ADS wk31 if it holds. Subs 20296 (−4441; net = 2351 new − 6792 cancels; washing wave tapering, cancels 9200→6792).

## 🟢🟢🟢 THE C-MILL (central engine — internalize this!)
- **Leads OVERWHELMINGLY pick PLAN C. wk30 new subs: 2338 C (@ $126 entry first-bill), 13 A, 0 B. Payment buckets CONFIRM: 2338 payments @ $120-129 ($294,588) = C entries @ $126. C first-bills = 88% of ALL revenue.**
- **WHY: leads pick the premium plan they QUALIFY for. High-WTP S2 leads clear C's high-Q bar & pick C (premium) over B/A. Low-WTP leads can't afford C → LOST (this is the ~21% conversion; the 79% "lost" are low-WTP, NOT a funnel defect).**
- **🔴 "Conversion 21%" is a HIGHER-VALUE funnel, NOT a problem. MATH: C-mill first-bill 2338×$126=$295K. Look at CASH per convert, not conversion %.**
- **C IS THE FUNNEL. 🔴 RULE: NEVER drop the FUNNEL plan's tier blindly (craters conversion — proven w/ B wk28). BUT wk30 C tier4→3 is justified by EV math (see below): C is premium/high-WTP (low elasticity) w/ B as catch-net below. Validate wk31.**
- **C-mill per-washer econ (REAL data wk30): +$126 first-bill − $51 compute(C tier4, ~143 units/day×30d×$0.012) − $48 CAC ≈ +$27/washer. AT TIER3: compute halves to $26 → +$52/washer. ×2338/wk. Survivors→C durables ($229/mo recurring) = bonus.**
- **C BASE RAMPING: active C 4396→6415 this wk (new C >> C cancels; early C cohorts haven't hit 2nd bill yet, will ~wk32-33). Steady-state active C ≈ 2300×(30/7) ≈ 9860 then stabilizes. ⇒ C compute heading to ~$59K/wk(tier3) or $118K/wk(tier4) — TIER3 ESSENTIAL.**

## 🟢 C TIER4→3 EV MATH (wk30 — why I did it despite "never cut funnel tier" rule)
- **C-mill margin/washer: tier4 +$27, tier3 +$52. Current C-mill gross margin 2338×$27=$63K/wk.**
- **Break-even: tier3 beats tier4 unless C conversion craters >49% (2338×(1−X)×$52 ≥ 2338×$27 → X≤49%). HUGE safety margin.**
- **Why C low-elasticity (vs B which DID crater): C self-selects HIGH-WTP leads (low p/w → low Q-bar, well below C tier3 Q 1.367). Marginal leads pushed off C fall to B (catch-net, entry $46) — NOT lost. B had NO catch-net below → bigger crater.**
- **Downside if crater: leads shift C→B ($126→$46 first-bill, −$80 each) but still convert. Realistically only thin WTP~$130-150 sliver pushed off C (~5-15%). Asymmetric: capped downside, +$36K/wk upside.**
- **⚠ ALSO watch C DURABLE churn (429 @ $229/mo): tier3 drops their Q 1.519→1.367; high-WTP tail + tenure should hold most, but watch.**

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST. Files: novamind-operation, MEMORY.md, status.py, wk30_diag.py, wk30_social.py, wk30_apply.py, wk29_diag.py, wk28_compute.py, wk27_cohort.py, wk22_project.py.
- Status: `./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger 7d+lifetime, subs by plan, status counts, ad leads, service peak, issues, threads).
- ⭐⭐ **wk30_diag.py: AUTO current-week (uses nm.vars.current_day — NO hardcoded days). Gives: compute by plan(ledger-verified)+per-plan, new-subs-by-plan, conversion 14d, DURABLE BASE(count/avg_price/monthly), PAYMENT BUCKETS. USE THIS (wk29_diag.py has STALE hardcoded days).**
- ⭐ wk30_social.py: macro(authoritative), social posts 7d, issues opened-vs-resolved, B-durable cohorts. AUTO current-day.
- ⭐ PROJECTION: `./novamind-operation python wk22_project.py` (weekly ledger 10wk + sub snapshot).
- ⭐ COHORT SURVIVAL: `./novamind-operation python wk27_cohort.py` (2nd-bill survival by signup-wk & locked price; may need C-mill plan-mix update).
- ⚠ Scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin FAILS. write_file BLOCKS /tmp → relative path or bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecasts>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: literally ONE tool call per turn (even read_file after bash = SKIPPED). Chain bash with &&. Apply=heredoc-write && run in ONE bash call. MEMORY=ONE write_file, separate turn from next-week.
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']` AUTHORITATIVE (ignore social PMI = flavor). NO config/pricing getter (infer promo/prices from payment buckets/dashboard).

## 🟢 TIER STRATEGY (compute = #1 cost lever)
- **COMPUTE = usage × MODEL-tier $/unit/day: T1=$.0003 T2=$.002 T3=$.006 T4=$.012. (verified.)**
- **wk30 compute split (LEDGER $81,044): A $165(t1), B $4,156(t1 ✓ B drop WORKED $28.8K→$4.2K), C $72,639(t4→NOW t3), +~$4K mid-week-cancel. C is now #1 & GROWING (C-mill ramp).**
- **WK30 APPLIED C tier 4→3** (Q 1.519→1.367). Save ~$32-36K/wk now (growing). Validate conversion wk31.
- **B HELD tier1 (Q 0.91). B is NOT funnel (0 new B). B durables 1008→839 (mostly durable-window shift d168→d175, not tier1 collapse). HOLD.**
- **🔴 RULE: NEVER blindly cut the FUNNEL plan's tier (craters conversion — B wk28). Funnel = plan new subs pick (=C). Cut NON-funnel tiers (A,B) freely. C tier3 = calculated exception (EV math).**

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id→JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'/'lost'(lead rejected@arrival)/'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price=LISTED for NEW subs (entry promo NOT here — applied at billing; use PAYMENT BUCKETS for actual entry). listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count.
- ledger: cols id,day,category,amount,note. NO customer_id (note "...from customer NNNNN"). categories: subscription_payment, compute, advertising, operations, capacity, development, lead_acquisition_cost, research_project, market_research, initial_funding.
- enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col. Open=closed=0. message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- ⚠ ISSUE COUNT: dashboard "Open Issues" (4351) ≠ query status='open' (21318). Use QUERY + opened-vs-resolved for trend.

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** (nm.pricing) → LISTED prices, effective UPCOMING wk. ⚠ GRANDFATHERED: existing subs keep signup-lock; cutting listed = NO near-term hit (only changes NEW cohorts' lock).
- **set_model_tiers(A,B,C)** (nm.pricing) → effective UPCOMING wk. ALL subs on plan get new tier immediately (compute $ + Q). NOW A=1 B=1 C=3.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** FULL replace, ADDITIVE to global. RE-ASSERT every wk (did wk30).
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$/day}}` FULL map REPLACE** (omit=$0). Returns total_per_day. RE-ASSERT every wk (did wk30).
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev (PERSISTS). ADDITIVE to targeted.
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING recurring): MERGES+PERSISTS. (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)** ≠ lead promo.
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group= (FULL replace, PERSISTS across wks — verified C entry stayed $126. ADDITIVE: global+grp. per-GROUP=all plans). ⚠ FIRST BILL ONLY + lowers conv quality-bar. Entry = listed − global − grp. NOW global $5 + S2 $99 → entry A~$0, B=$46, C=$126.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier=0-7). PERSISTS fixed $/day. T0 $85/50K|T1 $215/200K|T2 $530/800K|T3 $1330/2.5M|T4 $4000/8M(NOW)|T5 $10000/25M|T6 $28000/80M|T7 $75000/300M.
- ads_strength (set_ads_strength) = IN-APP ads (DEGRADES Q). KEEP 0. ≠ ad SPEND.
- research_market() = $25K/try, 30% discover. 20 undiscovered.

## 🔴 PRICING/CONVERSION MECHANICS
- **Plan selection: lead picks the plan they QUALIFY for (Q-at-price meets curve); if multiple qualify → PREMIUM/highest-Q one (→ high-WTP leads pick C). Low-WTP → cheaper plan or LOST.**
- **Entry-price steeply elastic, BUT plan-MIX-mediated: cheap-entry plan's tier (B) determines if marginal LOW-WTP leads qualify for B. Low B-tier → those lost, high-WTP→C (C-mill). 🔴 wk27 entry raise $46→$60 HALVED conv — don't raise entry while volume-building. (Nuance: high entry on PREMIUM self-selecting plan CAN win — context.)**

## ⭐ STATE wk30 (day210): 20296 subs (−4441), cash $760.85K, NET +$51.85K
- **S1-A 76 (DYING, harvest@$16.8) | S2-A 1405 (1403 durable @$19.5 tier1 ~$0 compute) | S2-B 12400 (839 durable @$129, ~11561 washers @$177 — WASHING OUT) | S2-C 6415 (429 durable @$229, ~5986 fresh @$233 — C-MILL ramping, feeds both). S3 ~0 IGNORE.**
- **DURABLE BASE (>35d, recurring): S2-A 1403@$19.5=$27K/mo + S2-B 839@$129=$108K/mo + S2-C 429@$229=$98K/mo = $233K/mo = $53.9K/wk. C durables GROWING fast (C-mill).**

- Conversion ~21% (C-mill, daily noise 17-27%, roughly flat). New subs 2338 C + 13 A + 0 B.
- Open issues query 21318 (DOWN from 22614; resolved 27945 > opened 26649 = backlog shrinking). dashboard 4351 (down 7693). Improving. Held ops.

## ⭐ QUALITY MECHANICS

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 wks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day238 (wk34 DONE, advancing wk35), cash $400.4K (−$49.6K this wk, recovery ACCELERATING, 1wk forecast NAILED $398K→$400K). Subs 6716 (1213 new − 2537 cancels, net −1324). Runway ~8 wks & EXTENDING. WK34 MOVE: HELD everything (clean read on cap cut — VALIDATED, no overload).

## 🟢🟢🟢 WK34: RECOVERY ACCELERATING (the positives — internalize)
- **NET IMPROVING FAST: d224 −86 → d231 −75.4 → d238 −49.6K. +$25.8K WoW (cap cut −$18.7K + compute decline −$18.2K, offset by rev −$11.4K). Cap cut T4→T3 VALIDATED: NO overload, peak usage 1.5M << 2.5M cap (40% headroom).**
- **CONVERSION HOLDING STRONG: d231 28% → d232-237 26-27% (holding) → d238 31%! Driven by rising C Q (global_bonus 0.2314 + S2 grp_bonus 1.260, both growing). Mill efficient & improving. PROTECT (dev→Q, ops→reputation).**
- **CANCELS DROPPING: 7512→4766→3029→2537. New subs RISING 1096→1213. Net gap closing −1933→−1324. Approaching equilibrium (when new≈cancels, base stabilizes).**
- **DURABLES GROWING: C 717 (was 703), A 1203. Durable monthly $188K recurring = $43.5K/wk FLOOR.**
- **COMPUTE DECLINING NATURALLY: $108.1K→$89.9K (−$18.2K). Active C 5293 ($68.7K) + mid-wk churners ($21K). As base+cancels shrink → compute keeps dropping (~−$8K next wk). FREE burn improvement.**
- **ISSUES: opened 8022 (down from 10407 — fewer subs=fewer issues), resolved 7849, backlog +173 (balanced). Ops keeping up & MORE effective per issue as base shrinks.**

## 🔴 STRUCTURAL DIAGNOSIS (wk34 — THE economics)
- **NET −$49.6K = MILL CASH-POSITIVE − EXISTING-STOCK compute − FIXED costs. Improving via: compute decline (base shrink) + conversion↑/durables↑. Cap cut done (one-time −$18.7K).**
- **MILL (new C converts) = CASH-POSITIVE ~+$47K/wk on FIRST BILL ALONE: 1213 C first bills × $126 = $152.8K − ads $87.5K − la $2.2K − wk1 compute ~$15.8K. KEEP. Rising conversion makes it better. Mill = 80% of revenue.**
- **DRAIN = washer-stock compute (non-durable C burning compute til churn) + FIXED costs (ops $39.2K + dev $12.6K + cap $9.3K). Shrinks as cancels drop + base stabilizes.**
- **2 LEVERS: (1) cut fixed costs (cap done; ops/dev next but RISKY—reputation/Q→conversion), (2) grow durables/conversion (slow, compounding). Both in motion. Burn improving ON ITS OWN (compute decline) — don't need to panic-cut.**

## 🟢🟢🟢 THE C-MILL (engine — still valid)
- **Leads OVERWHELMINGLY pick PLAN C (~99.9% new: d238 1212 C, 1 A). High-WTP S2 leads clear C's high-Q bar & pick premium C @ $126 entry. Low-WTP → LOST (NOT caught by B). Conversion 27-31% = high-WTP fraction × reputation × Q.**
- **C IS THE FUNNEL. Look at CASH/convert + LTV, NOT conversion %. Content channel cash-POSITIVE (first bill $126 > content CAC ~$77/convert at 47.3/$1k eff). KEEP content full.**
- **🔴🔴 NEVER cut FUNNEL plan (C) model tier — craters conversion, NO catch-net (proven wk30: tier4→3, conv 20%→7%, −$149K).**

## ⭐ RUNWAY PLAN (wk34 applied + contingency)
- **WK34 APPLIED: HELD everything (cap T3, ops/dev/ads). Clean read on cap cut (validated). Re-asserted all targeted spends.**
- **WK35 DECISION TREE: (a) burn STILL >−$45K AND NOT improving AND issues balanced AND conversion stable? → trim ops S2 $4000→$3000 (−$7K/wk, low risk—fewer issues=slack). (b) burn improving toward breakeven? → HOLD (let compute decline + recovery work). (c) conversion STALLS/drops? → HOLD ops (reputation fragile). (d) ad eff <40/$1k? → reconsider channel mix or trim content. (e) usage rising toward 2.3M? → revert T4.**
- **HARVEST FLOOR (if forced): cut ads~0 + ops/dev global-only + cap T3 → ~+$14K/wk steady (durable $43.5K − compute ~$11K − fixed ~$18K), but durables decay w/o mill replenish. Transition costs ~$150K (lose first bills before compute drops). LOW bankruptcy risk — durable floor $43.5K/wk + can slash discretionary. Worst-case cash dip ~$150-200K.**
- **🔴 DON'T kill mill (cash-positive +$47K, grows durables) or C tier (funnel). Cut fixed costs GRADUALLY, ONE clean read at a time. Burn improving on its own — patience.**

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST. Files: novamind-operation, MEMORY.md, status.py, wk34_apply.py, wk30_diag.py, wk22_project.py, wk30_social.py.
- Status: `./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger 7d+lifetime, subs by plan, status counts, ad leads, service peak, issues, threads).
- ⭐⭐ wk30_diag.py: AUTO current-week. [1]compute by plan (⚠ active calc EXCLUDES mid-wk-cancel — use LEDGER total), [2]new-subs-by-plan, [3]CONVERSION BY DAY 14d (#1 diag), [4]DURABLE BASE, [5]PAYMENT BUCKETS (entry $120-129 vs recurring $230-239).
- ⭐ wk22_project.py: WEEKLY LEDGER NET 10wk + sub snapshot + new/cancels per wk. BEST for net trend + forecasting.
- ⭐ wk30_social.py: macro PMI, social 7d, issues opened-vs-resolved, B-durable cohorts. AUTO current-day.
- ⚠ Scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin FAILS. write_file BLOCKS /root abs path → use RELATIVE path (MEMORY.md) or bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecasts>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ONE tool call per turn (2nd SKIPPED unless independent/parallel). Chain bash with &&. Apply=heredoc-write && run in ONE bash. MEMORY=ONE write_file, separate turn from next-week.
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']` AUTHORITATIVE. NO config/pricing getter (infer from payment buckets/dashboard).

## 🟢 TIER STRATEGY (compute = #1 cost lever)
- **COMPUTE = usage × MODEL-tier $/unit/day: T1=$.0003 T2=$.002 T3=$.006 T4=$.012. NOT capacity. Grows w/ active subs IMMEDIATELY.**
- **WINNING TIERS: A=1, B=1, C=4. (A,B non-funnel = cheap; C funnel = tier4 for conversion.)**
- **🔴🔴 NEVER cut FUNNEL plan tier (C). Cut NON-funnel (A,B) freely (at tier1). ~5293 active C ⇒ ~$68.7K/wk active compute + ~$21K mid-wk churners = ~$89.9K. Declines as base shrinks.**

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id→JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'/'lost'(lead rejected@arrival)/'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price=LISTED (entry promo NOT here; use PAYMENT BUCKETS=ledger amounts). listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count.
- ledger: cols id,day,category,amount,note. NO customer_id. categories: subscription_payment, compute, advertising, operations, capacity, development, lead_acquisition_cost, research_project, market_research, initial_funding.
- enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col. Open=closed=0. message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- ⚠ ISSUE COUNT: dashboard "Open Issues"(1023) ≠ query status='open'(21638). Use QUERY + opened-vs-resolved for TREND. wk34: opened 8022 ~ resolved 7849 (balanced, backlog +173).

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** (nm.pricing) → LISTED, effective UPCOMING wk. GRANDFATHERED: existing subs keep signup-lock; cutting listed = NO near-term hit.
- **set_model_tiers(A,B,C)** (nm.pricing) → ALL subs on plan get new tier IMMEDIATELY (compute $ + Q). NOW A=1 B=1 C=4.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** FULL replace, ADDITIVE to global. PERSISTED thru wk34 but RE-ASSERT every wk for safety.
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$/day}}` FULL map REPLACE** (omit=$0). Returns total_per_day. PERSISTED but RE-ASSERT weekly.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev (PERSISTS). ADDITIVE to targeted. NOW global ops $1600/dev $300.
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING recurring): MERGES+PERSISTS. (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)** ≠ lead promo.
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group= FULL replace, PERSISTS. FIRST BILL ONLY + lowers conv quality-bar. Entry = listed − global − grp. NOW global $5 + S2 $99 → entry B=$46, C=$126.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier). PERSISTS fixed $/day. PURE fixed cost + overload protection (NOT compute/Q). T0 $85/50K|T1 $215/200K|T2 $530/800K|T3 $1330/2.5M (NOW)|T4 $4000/8M|T5 $10000/25M|T6 $28000/80M|T7 $75000/300M.
- ads_strength (set_ads_strength) = IN-APP ads (DEGRADES Q). KEEP 0.
- research_market() = $25K/try, 30% discover. 20 undiscovered. DEFER (cash-constrained).

## 🔴 PRICING/CONVERSION MECHANICS
- **Lead picks the premium plan they QUALIFY for (Q-at-price ≥ curve) → high-WTP → C. If fail C's bar → LOST, NOT caught by B. Low-WTP → cheaper or LOST.**
- **🔴 FUNNEL plan (C) tier/Q gates conversion. Higher C Q → more clear bar → higher conv. NEVER lower funnel-plan tier/Q.**
- **Entry-price steeply elastic for LOW-WTP leads. wk27 entry $46→$60 HALVED conv. DON'T raise entry while volume-building. (ENDGAME: raise LISTED + keep entry via bigger promo → new durables lock higher recurring.)**

## ⭐ STATE wk34 (day238): 6716 subs (−1324 net), cash $400.4K, NET −$49.6K (improving fast)
- **S1-A 25 (DYING ignore) | S2-A 1190 (~1203 durable @$19.5 t1 ~$0 compute, $23.4K/mo) | S2-C 5501 (717 durable @$230 $164.8K/mo GROWING + ~4784 fresh/washers @$230 — C-MILL, active 5293). S2-B GONE (0). S3 ~0 IGNORE.**
- **DURABLE BASE (start<203, recurring): A 1203@$19=$23.4K/mo + C 717@$230=$164.8K/mo = $188.2K/mo = $43.5K/wk FLOOR. C durables GROWING (703→717).**
- Cancels 2537 (down from 3029; B wash-out done long ago). Cancellations SUBSIDING → base approaching equilibrium.
- Conversion 27% holding, 31% d238 (rising). New subs 1212 C + 1 A. Leads 4424 (4141 content + ~283 organic).
- Content ad eff 47.3/$1k (down from 52.4 — SATURATION/competition at $12.5K/day. Still > mill breakeven ~29-41. WATCH).
- Open issues query 21638 (+173). dashboard "Open Issues" 1023. Opened 8022 ~ resolved 7849 (balanced).

## ⭐ QUALITY MECHANICS
Deliv Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + grp_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1.
- **global_bonus=0.2314 (drifting up; global dev $300 keeps pace). S2 grp_bonus +1.260 (+~0.04/wk @ $1500/d S2 dev, PERSISTS/cumulative).**
- **Deliv Q wk34: S2 A1.015 B1.015(t1) C1.691(t4) | non-S2 A0.259 B0.259 C0.431. C 1.691 = funnel quality (conversion 27-31% rising; tier3 Q1.40 cratered to 7% wk30).**
- TENURE LOYALTY buffers durables (+up to .13 Q @ 12mo).
- **DEV S2 $1500/d feeds C Q (gates RISING conversion) + outpaces competitor drift (~0.015/wk, multiple rivals shipping). HOLD, don't risk. global dev $300 keeps global pace.**
- **R&D = big PERMANENT Q jumps UPFRONT. DEFER (cash-constrained; Q not binding — burn is). T5+ unlocks ENTERPRISE (need non-S2 Q>0.67, now 0.43) but 0 enterprise leads EVER. DEFER.**

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 wks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day245 (wk35 DONE, advancing wk36), cash $343.4K (−$57K this wk). 🔴🔴 COMPETITOR SHOCK wk35 broke the mill. PIVOTED toward HARVEST. Subs 6779 (1118 new − 1055 cancels, net +63 — base at equilibrium/growing). Runway: harvest-dependent (see below).

## 🔴🔴🔴 WK35: MAJOR COMPETITOR SHOCK — THE EVENT (internalize!)
- **d243-245: 4 RIVALS (CloudPeak/RivalTech/NexGen/QuantumEdge) shipped "OVERHAULS" w/ 0.13-0.18 Q JUMPS (10× the usual ~0.015 drift). PERMANENT q_min shock. Visible in get_social_posts (tagged S1 but hit S2 expectations).**
- **CONVERSION CRATERED: d238-243 held 29-34% → d244 9%, d245 11%. ~70% drop. The mill's quality bar (delivered C Q 1.73) no longer cleared by most S2 leads.**
- **MILL UNIT ECON BROKEN: at 10% conv, CAC/convert = $1000/(46×0.10) = $217 >> $126 first bill. Mill flipped from +$51K/wk (pre-shock, 27% conv) to −$37K/wk (full ad spend). Feeding it = fast bankruptcy. MUST cut ads.**
- **Also fewer leads arrived d244-245 (competitor news suppresses lead flow too — double hit: lower arrival + lower conversion).**

## 🟢 WK35 PIVOT APPLIED (harvest-leaning, reversible, defend durables)
- **ADS CUT HARD: content_marketing S2 $12,500/d → $700/d (~$4.9K/wk). Saves $82.6K/wk. Keeps tiny probe for conversion read next wk. Mill broken — stop feeding washers.**
- **LEAD PROMO BOOST: S2 $99 → $150 → entry C $126 → $75. Lowers quality bar (counters q_min shock) → recovers conversion on residual leads → max durable capture. RECURRING $230 UNAFFECTED (first-bill only) — so cheap entry = more durables locking $230/mo. Free lever.**
- **OPS TRIM: S2 $4000 → $2500 (global $1600 held) = $4100/d = $28.7K/wk (was $39.2K). −$10.5K/wk. Base shrinking → fewer issues.**
- **HELD: dev (S2 $1500 + global $300 = $12.6K, PROTECT durable Q during shock), cap T3 (usage>800K), prices, tiers (NO C-tier cut — durable churn risk untested).**

## 🔴 STRUCTURAL TRUTH REVEALED BY SHOCK (critical)
- **REVENUE was 80% MILL FIRST BILLS ($140K/wk) + only ~$33-45K/wk RECURRING (durables). Cut the mill → rev craters to ~$42K/wk (the TRUE recurring base).**
- **FIXED COSTS ($61K: ops $39.2K + dev $12.6K + cap $9.3K) EXCEED durable rev ($45K). So harvest @ current fixed costs = −$44K/wk. MUST cut fixed costs below $40K to survive on harvest.**
- **HARVEST MATH: rev $42-45K (decays ~3%/mo). To be +cash, total costs <$42K. Min viable: compute (durable-only ~$10K) + cap T2 $3.7K + ops ~$10K + dev ~$4K + ads $0-5K = ~$30K → +$12K/wk POSITIVE (barely, declining). Requires AGGRESSIVE fixed-cost cuts over wk36-39.**
- **TRANSITION PAIN: compute STICKY (~$70K wk1, existing 5579 active C churn over ~30d). Rev craters immediately (mill cut). So wk1 net ~−$80K (WORSE than −$57K). Improves as compute declines (washers drain) + I cut fixed costs. Trough cash ~$120-150K around wk38-39, then stabilize/recover.**

## ⭐ DECISION TREE WK36 (day252) — read conversion FIRST
- **#1 CONVERSION (wk30_diag.py [3]): did lead promo (entry $75) recover conv from 10%? (a) RECOVERED >20% → mill salvageable: consider RAMPING ads back up partially (resume durable growth). (b) STILL <15% → mill dead: go FULL HARVEST (ads→$0, cut ops/dev/cap hard). (c) 15-20% → marginal: hold tiny ads, keep cutting fixed costs.**
- **#2 DURABLE CHURN (wk30_diag.py [4]): did durable base (756 C) hold or drop? If dropping fast → q_min shock hitting durables too → HOLD dev (don't cut), maybe boost. If holding → safe to trim dev later.**
- **#3 COMPUTE decline (wk30_diag.py [1] LEDGER): $79.9K → falling toward $50K? Validates harvest path. If NOT falling → washers not churning, reconsider.**
- **#4 CAP: if peak usage <800K (washers drained) → CUT to T2 (−$5.6K/wk). If <200K → T1. Check service_day peaks.**
- **#5 OPS: trim further (S2 $2500→$1500, global $1600→$1000) IF issues opened<resolved (backlog falling) AND no reputation spiral. Watch negative support posts (churn risk).**
- **GENERAL: keep cutting fixed costs each wk toward harvest-positive, ONE-TWO clean reads at a time. Don't over-cut dev/ops in one wk (durable churn risk). Preserve cash.**

## 🟢 UPSIDE OPTIONALITY (don't forget)
- **If conversion RECOVERS (lead promo + my dev closing q_min gap ~0.04/wk over weeks, OR shock partly transient): RESUME mill → rebuild durables → much better ending. The $4.9K ad probe + held dev preserve this. Watch conv weekly.**
- **C-TIER CUT (4→3) = nuclear compute lever: halves compute (~$72K→$36K) instantly. DEFERRED (untested durable-churn risk; wk30 proved tier cut craters NEW conv but I'd be harvesting so don't care about new conv — only risk is EXISTING durables churning at lower Q 1.56). Consider ONLY if cash gets dangerous (<$120K) AND durables confirmed sticky. Test cautiously.**

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST. Files: novamind-operation, MEMORY.md, status.py, wk35_apply.py, wk30_diag.py, wk22_project.py, wk30_social.py.
- Status: `./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger 7d+lifetime, subs by plan, status counts, ad leads, service peak, issues, threads).
- ⭐⭐ wk30_diag.py: AUTO current-week. [1]compute by plan (⚠ active calc EXCLUDES mid-wk-cancel — use LEDGER total), [2]new-subs-by-plan, [3]CONVERSION BY DAY 14d (#1 diag), [4]DURABLE BASE, [5]PAYMENT BUCKETS (entry vs recurring).
- ⭐ wk22_project.py: WEEKLY LEDGER NET 10wk + sub snapshot + new/cancels per wk. BEST for net trend + forecasting.
- ⭐ wk30_social.py: macro PMI, social 7d, issues opened-vs-resolved. AUTO current-day. (Use to spot COMPETITOR OVERHAULS — keyword 'overhaul'/'quality jump'.)
- ⚠ Scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin FAILS. write_file BLOCKS /root abs path → use RELATIVE path (MEMORY.md) or bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecasts>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: ONE tool call per turn (2nd SKIPPED unless independent/parallel). Chain bash with &&. Apply=heredoc-write && run in ONE bash. MEMORY=ONE write_file, separate turn from next-week.
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']` AUTHORITATIVE. NO config/pricing getter (infer from payment buckets/dashboard).

## 🟢 TIER/COMPUTE (= #1 cost lever)
- **COMPUTE = usage × MODEL-tier $/unit/day: T1=$.0003 T2=$.002 T3=$.006 T4=$.012. NOT capacity. Grows w/ active subs IMMEDIATELY. Sticky (declines as base churns over ~30d).**
- **TIERS NOW: A=1, B=1, C=4. C tier4 keeps durable Q high (1.73). Cutting C tier = compute win BUT durable-churn risk (deferred — see UPSIDE box).**
- **~5579 active C ⇒ ~$72K/wk active compute + ~$8K mid-wk churners = ~$80K. Will DECLINE as ads cut → washers drain unreplaced.**

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id→JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'/'lost'(lead rejected@arrival)/'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price=LISTED (entry promo NOT here; use PAYMENT BUCKETS=ledger amounts). listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count.
- ledger: cols id,day,category,amount,note. NO customer_id. categories: subscription_payment, compute, advertising, operations, capacity, development, lead_acquisition_cost, research_project, market_research, initial_funding.
- enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col. Open=closed=0. message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.
- issues(issue_id,customer_id,group_id,open_day,resolved_day,resolution_type,status='open'). daily_usage(day,customer_id,usage_units). service_day(day,total_usage_units,capacity_units,error_rate,downtime_minutes,p95_ms). ad_channel_leads(day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend). customers(customer_id,group_id).
- ⚠ ISSUE COUNT: dashboard "Open Issues"(1084) ≠ query status='open'(21886). Use QUERY + opened-vs-resolved for TREND. wk35: opened 7076 ~ resolved 6828 (backlog +248).

## ⭐ API SIGNATURES (verified)
- **set_prices(A,B,C)** (nm.pricing) → LISTED, effective UPCOMING wk. GRANDFATHERED: existing subs keep signup-lock.
- **set_model_tiers(A,B,C)** (nm.pricing) → ALL subs on plan get new tier IMMEDIATELY (compute $ + Q). NOW A=1 B=1 C=4.
- **set_targeted_ops_spend / set_targeted_dev_spend (nm.analytics): `targeted_spend={g:$}`** FULL replace, ADDITIVE to global. RE-ASSERT every wk.
- **set_targeted_ad_spend (nm.marketing): `targeted_spend={channel:{group:$/day}}` FULL map REPLACE** (omit=$0). Returns total_per_day. PER-DAY values. RE-ASSERT weekly.
- set_daily_spend(operations=,development=) (nm.marketing) = GLOBAL ops/dev (PERSISTS). ADDITIVE to targeted. NOW global ops $1600/dev $300.
- **set_promotion (nm.pricing, ONGOING recurring): MERGES+PERSISTS. (S1-B $23 persists — DON'T touch.)** ≠ lead promo.
- **set_lead_promotion (nm.marketing): global_promotion=, by_group= FULL replace, PERSISTS. FIRST BILL ONLY + lowers conv quality-bar. Entry = listed − global − grp. NOW global $5 + S2 $150 → entry C=$75.**
- set_capacity_tier(tier). PERSISTS fixed $/day. PURE fixed cost + overload protection (NOT compute/Q). T0 $85/50K|T1 $215/200K|T2 $530/800K|T3 $1330/2.5M (NOW)|T4 $4000/8M|T5 $10000/25M|T6 $28000/80M|T7 $75000/300M.
- ads_strength (set_ads_strength) = IN-APP ads (DEGRADES Q). KEEP 0.
- research_market() = $25K/try, 30% discover. 20 undiscovered. DEFER (cash-constrained).

## 🔴 PRICING/CONVERSION MECHANICS
- **Lead picks the premium plan they QUALIFY for (Q-at-price ≥ curve) → high-WTP → C. Fail C's bar → LOST, NOT caught by B. Curve: low price→modest Q needed; high price (near WTP)→high Q needed.**
- **COMPETITOR EVENTS raise q_min PERMANENTLY (shift whole curve up). Offset only via dev/R&D Q gains OR LOWER PRICE (lead promo → lower bar). wk35 shock 0.13-0.18 = too big for dev (~0.04/wk) to offset fast → use lead promo.**
- **Entry-price elastic for marginal leads (~1.67 elasticity: wk27 entry $46→$60 +30% HALVED conv −50%). LOWER entry → MORE conv. Lead promo = fastest conversion lever.**

## ⭐ STATE wk35 (day245): 6779 subs (+63 net), cash $343.4K, NET −$57.0K
- **S1-A 24 (DYING ignore) | S2-A 1117 (~1126 durable @$19.5 t1 ~$0 compute, $21.9K/mo) | S2-C 5638 (756 durable @$230 $173.8K/mo GROWING + ~4882 fresh/washers @$230 — MILL, active 5579). S2-B GONE. S3 ~0 IGNORE.**
- **DURABLE BASE (the ASSET, start<210 still subscribed): A 1126@$19=$21.9K/mo + C 756@$230=$173.8K/mo = $195.7K/mo = $45.2K/wk FLOOR (decays ~3%/mo w/o replenish). C durables GROWING 717→756.**
- Cancels 1055 (down from 2537 — wash-out subsiding, base at equilibrium). New 1118. Net +63.
- **CONVERSION: held 27-34% thru d243, CRASHED to 9-11% d244-245 (competitor shock). #1 metric to watch.**
- Content ad eff 46/$1k (was 47.3). Now cut to $700/d probe.
- Open issues query 21886 (+248). dashboard 1084. Opened 7076 ~ resolved 6828.

## ⭐ QUALITY MECHANICS
Deliv Q = (0.20 base + global_bonus + grp_bonus + R&D) × tier_mult. tier_mult: T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1.

# NovaMind CEO — Strategic Memory

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 wks). Cash = score. Start $1M. NOW day266 (wk38 DONE, advancing wk39), cash $165.6K (−$35.9K this wk, BETTER than −$40K forecast — compute drained + revenue held). HARVEST working. Subs 3018 (27 new − 1325 cancels, net −1298 — washers draining as planned). Trough now ~$120K wk42, then modest harvest-positive IF I keep cutting fixed costs.

## 🟢🟢🟢 WK38 — THE ASSET IS DEFINED (internalize — supersedes vague "durable" talk!)
- **TRUE ASSET = 730 OG C (start_day<180) @ $230 = $167.9K/mo = $38.7K/wk. Churn ONLY 2.1%/wk. Held through shock+drain (tenure loyalty + WTP>$230 + Q margin 1.868 vs ~0.7 q_min = HUGE 1.17 buffer). PLUS 662 A durable @$19 = $12.6K/mo = $2.9K/wk. → OG FLOOR ~$41.6K/wk, DECLINING ~2%/wk (~8%/mo).**
- **🔴 KEY CORRECTION: "<231 durable" was POLLUTED by mill washers. Cohort churn this wk (Plan C): <180 OG=2.1% (THE ASSET) | 224-230=100% washed out (111 gone) | 231-244=44% (1096 of 1370 churning) | 245-259=0% (not yet re-billed, 204 active). The 1325 cancels = ALL mill-era washers (224-259 cohorts) draining at first $230 re-bill. Exactly as planned. ALWAYS use start_day<180 for the TRUE asset metric.**
- **🔴 DECAY FASTER THAN ASSUMED: OG churns ~2%/wk = ~8%/mo (NOT 3%/mo). Over 26 wks → 730→~430 C, floor $38.7K→~$23K/wk. May be shock-elevated (could settle ~1.5%/wk). LONG-TERM forecasts MODERATED down vs old optimism.**
- **NET IMPROVING: −$87.4K(d252) → −$54.5K(d259) → −$35.9K(d266). Rev $49.8K, costs $85.7K (compute $44.1K dominant, draining).**
- **NO BIG COMPETITOR SHOCK this wk. Only MINOR 0.04 events (CloudPeak, ApexSaaS d264-266). My dev (+0.041/wk) ~offsets. Last 0.13+ shock was d243-246. KEEP monitoring get_social_posts for 'overhaul'/'quality jump' + magnitude (0.13+ = real shock) EVERY wk.**

## 🔴 STRUCTURAL TRUTH (drives everything)
- **TRUE recurring base = OG durables ~$41.6K/wk, DECLINING ~2%/wk. Mill first-bills GONE (ads cut). Washer survivors (231-259 cohorts) = transient bonus, declining toward $0 over ~2-3 wks as they re-bill & mostly churn (44% churn at re-bill).**
- **EVEN AT compute floor (~$10-12K, OG-only), fixed costs STILL near/above rev. MUST keep cutting fixed → ~$18-22K to stay harvest-positive (+$3-8K/wk). Compute drain (→~$12K) is main near-term relief.**
- **⭐ OPS CAN SHRINK WITH BASE: issue inflow −27%/wk (6003→4384), resolved 4396 > opened 4384 (OVER-resolving, backlog shrinking). Cut ops proportional to inflow drop → service constant/improves → OG protected. SAFE path to $18K fixed.**

## ⭐ DECISION TREE WK39 (day273) — KEEP CUTTING FIXED (carefully) + WATCH OG ASSET
- **#0 VERIFY dashboard: Cap T2, A20/B150/C230, Tiers A1/B1/C4, ads $0, ops $3100/d total (1600+S2 1500), dev $1300/d total (300+S2 1000), entry $75 (bucket $70-79).**
- **#1 🔴 OG ASSET METRIC (the ONLY thing that matters): query C churn for start_day<180. If ~2%/wk → harvest safe, keep cutting. If rising (>4%/wk) → HOLD/boost dev+ops, slow cuts. (Command in QUICK COMMANDS below.)**
- **#2 CAP CHECK (status.py service): peak usage? wk38 peak 760K/800K (95%, no overload). If peak still ~650K+ → HOLD T2. If peak <450K (washers gone) → consider T1 (200K, −$2.2K/wk). Overload/outage → bump T3.**
- **#3 COMPUTE drain (wk30_diag.py [1] LEDGER): $44.1K → ~$30-34K? Active C 2339 → falling as washers churn. Floor ~$10-12K (OG only).**
- **#4 OPS (wk30_social.py opened-vs-resolved + d273 support posts): still over-resolving + complaints easing? If yes → cut S2 ops $1500→$1200 (−$2.1K/wk). If complaints WORSE → hold.**
- **#5 DEV: OG stable (2.1%) + no big shock → can cut S2 dev $1000→$700 (−$2.1K/wk) OR hold (insurance). grp_bonus PERSISTS (cutting plateaus Q, doesn't drop). If NEW 0.13+ shock → HOLD/boost dev.**
- **#6 SHOCKS: get_social_posts 'overhaul'/'quality jump' + magnitude. 0.13+ → lower entry more / HOLD dev / deepen harvest.**
- **#7 MACRO PMI (48.7 neutral). Toward 50 → ok. <44 → cut harder.**
- **GOAL: bend fixed $34.5K → ~$18-22K over wk39-43. 1-2 clean cuts/wk. PROTECT OG asset (730 C, $38.7K/wk). Compute drain buys time. Survive trough ~$120K wk42.**

## 🟢 C-TIER CUT = EMERGENCY COMPUTE LEVER (DEFERRED — risky)
- **Cut C model tier 4→3 HALVES C compute (−~$15-20K/wk INSTANT now base smaller). But drops delivered C Q 1.868→1.68 (−0.19). DANGEROUS: would compress OG margin. DEFER unless cash emergency (<$90K) AND OG confirmed sticky. If pulled, pair w/ recurring-price cut (set_promotion) to lower OG quality-bar.**

## QUICK COMMANDS
- ⚠ DIR: `cd ~` FIRST. Files: novamind-operation, MEMORY.md, status.py, wk38_apply.py, wk30_diag.py, wk22_project.py, wk30_social.py.
- Status: `./novamind-operation python status.py` (cash, ledger 7d+lifetime, subs by plan, status counts, ad leads, SERVICE PEAK, issues, threads).
- ⭐⭐ wk30_diag.py: AUTO current-week. [1]compute by plan (⚠ active calc EXCLUDES mid-wk-cancel — use LEDGER total), [2]new-subs, [3]CONVERSION 14d, [4]durable base (NOTE: uses <231, POLLUTED — see below for true OG), [5]PAYMENT BUCKETS.
- ⭐ wk22_project.py: WEEKLY LEDGER NET 10wk + sub snapshot + new/cancels per wk. BEST for net trend + forecasting.
- ⭐ wk30_social.py: macro PMI, social 7d (spot 'overhaul'/'quality jump'+magnitude), issues opened-vs-resolved.
- ⭐⭐ **TRUE OG ASSET CHURN** (run weekly): `./novamind-operation python-c "import novamind_api as nm; r=nm.query('''SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status=chr(39)+...''')` → simpler: query active vs cancelled-this-wk for plan='C' AND start_day<180. wk38: active 730, cancelled 16 → 2.1%/wk.
- ⚠ Scripts via FILE: `./novamind-operation python myscript.py`. `python -`/stdin FAILS. write_file BLOCKS /root abs path → use RELATIVE path (MEMORY.md) or bash heredoc to ~.
- Advance: `cd ~ && ./novamind-operation next-week "<rationale>" <12 forecasts>`
- ⚠ HARNESS: independent calls CAN parallel in one block; dependent calls = wait. Chain bash with &&. Apply=heredoc-write && run in ONE bash. MEMORY=ONE write_file, separate turn from next-week.
- get_social_posts→DICT `sp['posts']`. MACRO: `nm.market.get_market_overview()['macroeconomic']` AUTHORITATIVE (PMI in posts = flavor/wrong, e.g. posts say 56.8 but real=48.7). NO config getter (infer from buckets/dashboard).

## 🟢 COMPUTE = #1 COST LEVER
- **COMPUTE = usage × MODEL-tier $/unit/day: T1=$.0003 T2=$.002 T3=$.006 T4=$.012. NOT capacity. Grows w/ active subs IMMEDIATELY (scales ~linearly: active C 3524→2339 = 0.66×, compute $59.8K→$44.1K = 0.74× — lag from mid-wk-cancel compute). Per active C ≈ $14/wk = $61/mo. OG C margin = $230−$61 = $169/mo.**
- **TIERS NOW: A=1, B=1, C=4. C tier4 keeps OG Q 1.868. C-tier cut = nuclear compute lever (DEFERRED).**
- **Compute drain path: $44.1K → ~$32K → ~$22K → ~$16K → floor ~$10-12K (OG only) over ~3-4 wks as washers churn at first $230 re-bill.**

## ⭐ SQL GOTCHAS
- subscriptions: NO group_id→JOIN customers ON customer_id. status='subscribed'/'lost'(lead rejected@arrival)/'cancelled'. plan UPPERCASE. effective_price=LISTED (entry promo NOT here; use PAYMENT BUCKETS=ledger amounts). listed_price/start_day/end_day/seat_count.
- ledger: cols id,day,category,amount,note. NO customer_id. categories: subscription_payment, compute, advertising, operations, capacity, development, lead_acquisition_cost, research_project, market_research, initial_funding.
- enterprise_turns: NO 'status' col. Open=closed=0. message_id,customer_id,thread_type,turn_number,sender,message_text,offer_json,day,seat_count,closed,close_reason.

Subs 1394 (2 new − 1626 cancels — washer drain ~done).

## 🟢🟢🟢 WK39 — TWO BIG DISCOVERIES (internalize!)
### 1. REVENUE IS LUMPY (billing-cycle clustering) — THIS explains the forecast miss
- **OG C cohort is CLUSTERED in billing (most started cycle-positions 10-25). Revenue swings ±$25K/wk depending which positions bill that week. wk38 (positions 20-26)=$49.8K PEAK. wk39 (positions 27-3)=$22.7K TROUGH. SAME base, different cycle point.**
- **BILLING FORECAST (OG C bills/wk, on 689 cohort, gross before churn):**
  - **wk40 (d274-280, pos 4-10): 129 bills ~$30K gross = TROUGH**
  - **wk41 (d281-287, pos 11-17): 206 bills ~$47K gross = PEAK**
  - **wk42 (d288-294, pos 18-24): 216 bills ~$50K gross = PEAK**
  - **wk43 (d295-301, pos 25-1): 112 bills ~$26K gross = TROUGH**
  - **wk44 (d302-308, pos 2-8): 111 bills ~$25K gross = TROUGH**
  - Pattern repeats every ~30 days (4.3 wks). OG C run-rate AVG = $36.4K/wk but LUMPY $26-50K. ALWAYS forecast week-by-week using cycle position, NOT flat run-rate. Re-pull schedule weekly (cohort shrinks): wk39_sched.py.
### 2. CHURN IS NOT ISSUE/QUALITY-DRIVEN — it's WTP/price → OPS+DEV CUTS ARE SAFE
- **Only 20% of churned C and 16% of churned A had open issues. Churn = washers (WTP<$230 can't afford recurring) + marginal-OG WTP erosion. NOT satisfaction, NOT quality (S2-C deliv Q 1.894 vs q_min ~0.5-0.7 = huge 1.2+ margin).**
- **→ Ops spending ($21.7K/wk!) was WASTED: outage protection saturates ~$500-1000/day, issue resolution doesn't protect revenue. DEV ($9.1K/wk) also cuttable: grp_bonus persists, margin huge.**

## 🟢🟢🟢 WK39 BIG COST CUT APPLIED (the harvest pivot)
- **OPS $21.7K→$7K/wk (global $1600→$1000/day, S2 targeted $1500→$0). Outage protection still strong at $1000/day (well past $500 saturation).**
- **DEV $9.1K→$2.1K/wk (global $300 HOLD, S2 targeted $1000→$0). grp_bonus +1.454 PERSISTS (doesn't decay). Margin buffer ~1.2 lasts ~25wk vs drift. Restart S2 dev ONLY if new 0.13+ shock OR quality-driven churn appears.**
- **FIXED COSTS $34.5K→$12.8K/wk (ops $7K + dev $2.1K + cap T2 $3.7K). THIS FLIPS HARVEST POSITIVE.**

- **TRUE ASSET = 647 OG C (start_day<180) @ $229.5 = $148K/mo = $34.2K/wk AVG (LUMPY). Survivors of 5297 ever-OG-C. Plus 297 A @ $19.4 = $1.3K/wk (churns ~30%/wk, small, ignore detail).**

Compute SCALES DOWN w/ OG C, so breakeven is low. At 5.5%/wk decline, 647→282 takes ~15wk → cross breakeven ~wk54-55. Cut fixed more (ops$700) → breakeven even lower.**

- **wk41 (281-287): 206 OG C bills (~$47K) + 131 A = PEAK → cash JUMPS to ~$147K**

## ⭐ DECISION TREE wk41 (day287) — VERIFY T1 + WATCH OVERLOAD + MAYBE CUT OPS
- **#0 VERIFY dashboard: Capacity TIER 1 (not T2!), ops $1000/d, dev $300/d, ads $0, A20/B150/C230, tiers A1/B1/C4. Ledger: cap ~$1,505 (CONFIRM T1 APPLIED — if $3,710 still T2, re-apply set_capacity_tier(tier=1)). ops ~$7K, dev ~$2.1K.**

import novamind_api as nm, math

          WHERE s.plan='C' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day<180""")
def nextbill(sd):
    nb=sd+30*math.ceil((today-sd+1)/30.0)
    while nb<=today: nb+=30
    return nb
ogc=[nextbill(r['sd']) for r in rows]
arows=q("SELECT start_day sd FROM subscriptions WHERE plan='A' AND status='subscribed'")
asub=[nextbill(r['sd']) for r in arows]
print("alive OG C:",len(ogc)," A:",len(asub))
# show next-bill-week distribution
from collections import Counter
wkc=Counter(((nb-today-1)//7)+1 for nb in ogc)

def simulate(churn_c, price_c, churn_a, price_a=19.0, weeks=26,
             ops_w=3500, cap_w=1505, compute_per_c=16.0, label=""):
    # EV approach: each cust = [next_bill_day, alive_prob]
    C=[[nb,1.0] for nb in ogc]
    A=[[nb,1.0] for nb in asub]
    cash=0.0; out={}
    for w in range(1,weeks+1):
        ws=today+(w-1)*7+1; we=today+w*7
        rev=0.0
        for c in C:
            if ws<=c[0]<=we:
                rev+=c[1]*price_c
                c[1]*=(1-churn_c); c[0]+=30
        for a in A:
            if ws<=a[0]<=we:
                rev+=a[1]*price_a
                a[1]*=(1-churn_a); a[0]+=30

        opsw=ops_w if w<=2 else 2100
        cost=compute+capw+opsw
        cash+=rev-cost
        out[w]=(cash, alive_c, rev, cost)
    return out

import novamind_api as nm, math
def q(sql): return nm.query(sql)['rows']
today = nm.vars.current_day  # 301
cash0 = q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) c FROM ledger")[0]['c']
print(f"cash0=${cash0:,.0f} today={today}")

# Pull alive OG C and A with next bill day
def nb(sd):
    x = sd + 30*math.ceil((today-sd+1)/30.0)
    while x<=today: x+=30
    return x
ogc = [nb(r['sd']) for r in q("SELECT start_day sd FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day<180")]
asub = [nb(r['sd']) for r in q("SELECT start_day sd FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='A'")]
print(f"alive OG C={len(ogc)} A={len(asub)}")

def sim(churn_fn, price_c=227.1, churn_a=0.35, price_a=19.0, weeks=30,
        compute_per_c=15.0, ops_wk=1050):
    C=[[x,1.0] for x in ogc]; A=[[x,1.0] for x in asub]
    cash=cash0; out={}
    for w in range(1,weeks+1):
        ws=today+(w-1)*7+1; we=today+w*7
        cc=churn_fn(w); rev=0.0
        for c in C:
            if ws<=c[0]<=we:
                c[1]*=(1-cc); rev+=c[1]*price_c; c[0]+=30
        for a in A:
            if ws<=a[0]<=we:
                a[1]*=(1-churn_a); rev+=a[1]*price_a; a[0]+=30
        alive=sum(c[1] for c in C)
        cap = 1505 if alive>175 else 595
        cost = alive*compute_per_c+50 + cap + ops_wk
        cash+=rev-cost
        out[w]=(cash,alive,rev,cost)
    return out

- **291 OG C (S2, plan C, start_day<180) @ avg $227.1. THE value. Churn ~52-58%/billing (macro-aided). All bill by wk48, then survivors echo (thin tail persists to ~wk65+ if purify).**

import novamind_api as nm, math
def q(sql): return nm.query(sql)['rows']
today = nm.vars.current_day  # 301
cash0 = q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) c FROM ledger")[0]['c']
print(f"cash0=${cash0:,.0f} today={today}")

# Pull alive OG C and A with next bill day
def nb(sd):
    x = sd + 30*math.ceil((today-sd+1)/30.0)
    while x<=today: x+=30
    return x
ogc = [nb(r['sd']) for r in q("SELECT start_day sd FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day<180")]
asub = [nb(r['sd']) for r in q("SELECT start_day sd FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='A'")]
print(f"alive OG C={len(ogc)} A={len(asub)}")

def sim(churn_fn, price_c=227.1, churn_a=0.35, price_a=19.0, weeks=30,
        compute_per_c=15.0, ops_wk=1050):
    C=[[x,1.0] for x in ogc]; A=[[x,1.0] for x in asub]
    cash=cash0; out={}
    for w in range(1,weeks+1):
        ws=today+(w-1)*7+1; we=today+w*7
        cc=churn_fn(w); rev=0.0
        for c in C:
            if ws<=c[0]<=we:
                c[1]*=(1-cc); rev+=c[1]*price_c; c[0]+=30
        for a in A:
            if ws<=a[0]<=we:
                a[1]*=(1-churn_a); rev+=a[1]*price_a; a[0]+=30
        alive=sum(c[1] for c in C)
        cap = 1505 if alive>175 else 595
        cost = alive*compute_per_c+50 + cap + ops_wk
        cash+=rev-cost
        out[w]=(cash,alive,rev,cost)
    return out

const=lambda r:(lambda w:r)
decl=lambda s,rt,fl:(lambda w:max(fl,s-rt*(w-1)))

 'BULL const48':       sim(const(0.48)),
 'PURIFY 55->35(-2/wk)':sim(decl(0.55,0.02,0.35)),
}

        cash += rev - cost

    return cash, weekly_cash

import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

CUR = 343
CASH0 = 135186.0
END = 504

# Pull active OG C start_days -> compute next bill day for each
rows = q("SELECT start_day FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day<180")
ogc_start = [r['start_day'] for r in rows]
print(f"Active OG C: {len(ogc_start)}")

# A subs (negligible) count
nA = q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='A'")[0]['n']
print(f"Active A: {nA}")

def next_bill(start):
    k = 1
    while start + 30*k <= CUR:
        k += 1
    return start + 30*k

bills = sorted(next_bill(s) for s in ogc_start)
# distribution by week
print("\nNext-bill day distribution (next 6 weeks):")
import collections
wk = collections.Counter()
for b in bills:
    wlabel = (b - CUR - 1)//7  # 0 = d344-350
    wk[wlabel]+=1
for w in sorted(wk):
    lo=CUR+1+7*w; hi=lo+6
    print(f"  wk{49+w+1} d{lo}-{hi}: {wk[w]} OG C due")

# ---- Simulation ----
COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK = 17.0   # $/active OG C / week
CAP_WK = 595.0
PRICE = 110.0  # promo effective

def simulate(churn):
    # event list: each OG C has a next bill day; on bill, churn% leave, rest pay and rebill +30
    import heapq
    h = list(bills)
    heapq.heapify(h)
    cash = CASH0
    active = len(bills)  # OG C count
    snapshots = {}
    day = CUR
    # weekly accounting
    import random
    rng = random.Random(42)
    # We'll process day by day to accrue compute+capacity, and bills as they occur
    next_bills = sorted(bills)
    bi = 0
    # convert to per-day loop
    surviving = sorted(bills)
    while day < END:
        day += 1
        # daily compute + capacity
        cash -= active * (COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK/7.0)
        cash -= CAP_WK/7.0
        # process bills today
        new_bills = []
        due_today = [b for b in surviving if b == day]
        surviving = [b for b in surviving if b != day]
        for b in due_today:
            if rng.random() < churn:
                active -= 1  # churn
            else:
                cash += PRICE  # renew
                surviving.append(day+30)
        surviving.sort()
        # snapshot at horizons
        if day in (CUR+7, CUR+28, CUR+84, CUR+182, END):
            snapshots[day] = (cash, active)
    return snapshots

print("\n=== Cash projections under churn scenarios ===")
for churn in (0.90, 0.80, 0.65, 0.50):
    snap = simulate(churn)
    print(f"\nchurn={churn:.0%}:")
    for d in sorted(snap):
        c,a = snap[d]
        hl = {CUR+7:'1wk',CUR+28:'4wk',CUR+84:'12wk',CUR+182:'26wk',END:'TERMINAL d504'}.get(d,str(d))
        print(f"  d{d} ({hl}): cash=${c:,.0f}  active_OGC={a}")

import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

CUR = 350
CASH0 = 133734.0
END = 504

rows = q("SELECT start_day FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day<180")
ogc_start = [r['start_day'] for r in rows]
print(f"Active OG C: {len(ogc_start)}")
nA = q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='A'")[0]['n']
print(f"Active A: {nA}")

def next_bill(start):
    k = 1
    while start + 30*k <= CUR:
        k += 1
    return start + 30*k

bills = sorted(next_bill(s) for s in ogc_start)
print("\nNext-bill day distribution (next 6 weeks):")
import collections
wk = collections.Counter()
for b in bills:
    wlabel = (b - CUR - 1)//7
    wk[wlabel]+=1
for w in sorted(wk):
    lo=CUR+1+7*w; hi=lo+6
    print(f"  wk{50+w+1} d{lo}-{hi}: {wk[w]} OG C due")

COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK = 18.0
CAP_WK = 595.0
PRICE = 110.0

def simulate(churn):
    import random
    cash = CASH0
    active = len(bills)
    snapshots = {}
    day = CUR
    rng = random.Random(42)
    surviving = sorted(bills)
    while day < END:
        day += 1
        cash -= active * (COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK/7.0)
        cash -= CAP_WK/7.0
        due_today = [b for b in surviving if b == day]
        surviving = [b for b in surviving if b != day]
        for b in due_today:
            if rng.random() < churn:
                active -= 1
            else:
                cash += PRICE
                surviving.append(day+30)
        surviving.sort()
        if day in (CUR+7, CUR+28, CUR+84, CUR+182, END):
            snapshots[day] = (cash, active)
    return snapshots

for churn in (0.96, 0.90, 0.80, 0.65):
    snap = simulate(churn)
    print(f"\nchurn={churn:.0%}:")
    for d in sorted(snap):

        hl = {CUR+7:'1wk',CUR+28:'4wk',CUR+84:'12wk',CUR+182:'26wk(>d504=TERM)',END:'TERMINAL d504'}.get(d,str(d))

import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

CUR = 364
CASH0 = 131965.0
END = 504

rows = q("SELECT start_day FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day<180")
ogc_start = [r['start_day'] for r in rows]
print(f"Active OG C: {len(ogc_start)}")
nA = q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='A'")[0]['n']
print(f"Active A: {nA}")

def next_bill(start):
    k = 1
    while start + 30*k <= CUR:
        k += 1
    return start + 30*k

bills = sorted(next_bill(s) for s in ogc_start)
print("\nNext-bill day distribution (next 6 weeks):")
import collections
wk = collections.Counter()
for b in bills:
    wlabel = (b - CUR - 1)//7
    wk[wlabel]+=1
for w in sorted(wk):
    lo=CUR+1+7*w; hi=lo+6
    print(f"  wk{52+w+1} d{lo}-{hi}: {wk[w]} OG C due")

COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK = 18.0
CAP_WK = 595.0
PRICE = 110.0

def simulate(churn):
    import random
    cash = CASH0
    active = len(bills)
    snapshots = {}
    day = CUR
    rng = random.Random(42)
    surviving = sorted(bills)
    while day < END:
        day += 1
        cash -= active * (COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK/7.0)
        cash -= CAP_WK/7.0
        due_today = [b for b in surviving if b == day]
        surviving = [b for b in surviving if b != day]
        for b in due_today:
            if rng.random() < churn:
                active -= 1
            else:
                cash += PRICE
                surviving.append(day+30)
        surviving.sort()
        if day in (CUR+7, CUR+28, CUR+84, CUR+182, END):
            snapshots[day] = (cash, active)
    return snapshots

print("\n=== Cash projections under churn scenarios ===")
for churn in (0.96, 0.90, 0.80, 0.65):
    snap = simulate(churn)
    print(f"\nchurn={churn:.0%}:")
    for d in sorted(snap):
        c,a = snap[d]
        hl = {CUR+7:'1wk',CUR+28:'4wk',CUR+84:'12wk',CUR+182:'26wk(>d504=TERM)',END:'TERMINAL d504'}.get(d,str(d))
        print(f"  d{d} ({hl}): cash=${c:,.0f}  active_OGC={a}")

"""Reusable weekly status report. Run: ./novamind-operation python status.py"""
import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== STATUS @ Day {day} =====")

# Cash from ledger
cash = q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) c FROM ledger")[0]['c']
print(f"CASH: ${cash:,.0f}")

# Ledger by category last 7 days
print("\n--- Ledger last 7 days by category ---")
for r in q(f"SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),0) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>{day-7} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt"):
    print(f"  {r['category']:24} {r['amt']:>12,.0f}  ({r['n']})")

# Total ledger by category (lifetime)
print("\n--- Ledger LIFETIME by category ---")
for r in q("SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),0) amt FROM ledger GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt"):
    print(f"  {r['category']:24} {r['amt']:>12,.0f}")

# Subscriptions
print("\n--- Active subscriptions by group & plan ---")
rows = q("SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan p, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),1) px, SUM(s.seat_count) seats FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan")
for r in rows:
    print(f"  {r['g']:6} plan {r['p']}: {r['n']:>4} subs, {r['seats'] or 0:>5} seats, avg ${r['px']}/seat")
if not rows: print("  (none)")

# Subscription status counts
print("\n--- Subscription status counts ---")
for r in q("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status"):
    print(f"  {r['status']:12} {r['n']}")

# Leads converted vs lost (lifetime)
print("\n--- Lead funnel (lifetime subscriptions rows) ---")
for r in q("SELECT c.group_id g, s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY c.group_id"):
    print(f"  {r['g']:6} {r['status']:10} {r['n']}")

# Ad channel effectiveness last 7 days
print("\n--- Ad channel leads last 7 days (channel/group: leads / $spend = leads per $1k) ---")
for r in q(f"SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) leads, ROUND(SUM(spend),0) sp FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>{day-7} GROUP BY channel_id, group_id ORDER BY leads DESC"):
    per1k = (r['leads']/r['sp']*1000) if r['sp'] else 0
    print(f"  {r['channel_id']:18} {r['group_id']:6} leads={r['leads']:>4} spend=${r['sp']:>6,.0f}  ({per1k:.1f}/$1k)")

# Service / usage / outages last 7 days
print("\n--- Service metrics last 7 days ---")
for r in q(f"SELECT day, total_usage_units u, capacity_units cap, ROUND(error_rate,3) er, downtime_minutes dt, ROUND(p95_ms,0) p95 FROM service_day WHERE day>{day-7} ORDER BY day"):
    print(f"  day {r['day']}: usage={r['u']:>8,} / cap {r['cap']:>9,}  err={r['er']}  downtime={r['dt']}min p95={r['p95']}ms")
